title: Seven-Colored Puppeteer
tagline: Seven-Colored Puppeteer; Magician, puppeteer
theme_music: Plastic Mind (Mystic Square)
first_appearance: Mystic Square (Cover, Stage 3 Boss, Extra Boss)
who_they_are: Alice Margatroid (アリス・マーガトロイド) is a Youkai magician who can controls dolls and lives in a house within the Forest of Magic not far away from the home of Marisa Kirisame. She became a playable character in multiple games since Imperishable Night, in a team along Marisa, and. She also is a possible supporting character for Marisa.
personality: Alice is someone that is generally indifferent to others. As an "indoor type" person, she does not know much about the outside of the Forest of Magic, and hardly ventures outside of it, spending most of her time alone. While she puts on a confident attitude, she also has a timid side.

allies.name: Marisa Kirisame
allies.summary: Marisa Kirisame is a fellow magician of the Forest of Magic. They were partners, and she was supporting Marisa.

allies.name: Mima
allies.summary: At the end of Mystic Square, Mima takes Alice as her maid, releasing her some time later.

allies.name: Louise
allies.summary: Fellow resident associated with the mystic realm of Makai.

allies.name: Medicine Melancholy
allies.summary: Medicine was seen chatting with Alice Margatroid on chapter 9 of Silent Sinner in Blue. In a Touhou Station video, ZUN lists Medicine as a Touhou character whose relationship with Alice is consistently close, confirming that they are at least aware of each other in a positive light.

rivals.name: Three Fairies of Light
rivals.summary: Alice is one of the few youkai the Three Fairies have sought assistance from. Although they lied to Alice telling her that they weren't fairies who prank humans, at the end she decided that being bit by birds is enough and she let them leave her house without any grudge.

rivals.name: Sakuya Izayoi
rivals.summary: In Immaterial and Missing Power she gets lost in the Forest of Magic and Alice escorts her out. Also, she fights Alice as a way to relieve stress on her break.

acquaintances.name: Eirin Yagokoro
acquaintances.summary: Alice is a regular customer at Eientei, purchasing the Butterfly Dream Pill from Eirin. However, Eirin herself declined on commenting any more details.

allies.name: Yuiman Asama

allies.name: Nareko Michigami
allies.summary: Fellow resident and companion associated with Asama Purifying Mountain (浅間浄穢山).

acquaintances.name: Eirin Yagokoro
acquaintances.summary: Eirin asked Ariya to freeze Gensokyo into an internal loop in order to stop the impurity coming from the outside, while guaranteeing her that the protagonists would come and defeat her, before the events of Fossilized Wonders.

acquaintances.name: Watatsuki no Toyohime
acquaintances.summary: Toyohime was the one who unsealed Ariya from the shrine to use her power to preserve the Lunar Capital's purity. It's unknown whether the two have met or interacted directly.

title: The Guardian Beast Devoted to Shintoism and Buddhism
tagline: Komainu guardian beast of the Hakurei Shrine
theme_music: A Pair of Divine Beasts (Hidden Star in Four Seasons, Unfinished Dream of All Living Ghost)
first_appearance: Hidden Star in Four Seasons (Stage 3 Boss)
who_they_are: Aunn Komano is a komainu that guards places of worship. She has the ability to locate places of spirituality for Shintoism and Buddhism. Aunn is simple-minded but very friendly. She often loiters around shrines to guard them, especially the Hakurei Shrine, although nobody except Reimu knows who she is. Aunn has green eyes, long curly jade hair, pointy ears and a single grey horn. She wears a red short sleeved kariyushi shirt with white cloud designs, baggy white shorts with red cloud designs and wooden sandals.
key_facts: A single-horned lion-dog statue spirit who materialized to guard the Hakurei Shrine, Myouren Temple, and Moriya Shrine.
Detects the presence of gods and spiritual faith instinctively, often greeting visitors at the Hakurei torii gate before Reimu notices them.
personality: Cheerful, loyal, and enthusiastic; speaks with warm, dog-like earnestness and eagerness to help around the shrine grounds.

allies.name: Clownpiece
allies.summary: Fellow resident and companion associated with Hakurei Shrine (博麗神社).

allies.name: Mima
allies.summary: Fellow resident and companion associated with Hakurei Shrine (博麗神社).

allies.summary: Fellow resident and companion associated with Hakurei Shrine (博麗神社).

allies.name: Suika Ibuki
allies.summary: Fellow resident and companion associated with Hakurei Shrine (博麗神社).

allies.name: Rumia
allies.summary: Fellow resident and companion associated with Shrine Approach & Toriimoto Woods (博麗神社参道).

acquaintances.name: Reimu Hakurei
acquaintances.summary: Aunn had known Reimu for a long time, guarding the shrine at times when Reimu was gone. On the other hand, Reimu had no idea who Aunn was before the Four Seasons Incident and initially mistook her for an intruder.

acquaintances.name: Marisa Kirisame
acquaintances.summary: Like with Reimu, Aunn was familiar with Marisa due to seeing her at the shrine, but Marisa had no idea who Aunn was and immediately assumed she was the cause of the Four Seasons Incident.

acquaintances.name: Okina Matara
acquaintances.summary: Okina is the one responsible for Aunn gaining form as a youkai. This was caused by the magical energy coming out from one of Okina's doors on the back of a regular komainu statue.

acquaintances.name: Son Biten
acquaintances.summary: Although at first Biten greeted Aunn with a monkey – dog joke to justify the fight, she later apologized and told Aunn that she was being manipulated and that she could go to Hell to solve the incident.

title: Traditional Reporter of Fantasy
tagline: Crow tengu reporter, editor-in-chief of the Bunbunmaru Newspaper, and high-speed aerial scout of Youkai Mountain
theme_music: 風神少女 (Short Version) (Phantasmagoria of Flower View)
first_appearance: Phantasmagoria of Flower View (Playable Character, Possible Opponent)
who_they_are: Aya Shameimaru is a crow tengu reporter. She has power to manipulate wind. Aya is one of the strongest tengu, and one of the fastest. Aya lives somewhere on Youkai Mountain. She always looks for gossip, relying on aggressive reporting tactics and is prone to exaggerate. While Aya actually cares about the truth, she is somewhat full of herself. Aya runs a newspaper called the Bunbunmaru. She is Hatate's rival. Aya has red eyes and shoulder-length black hair. She wears a white blouse with a black ribbon, black skirt, red geta sandals and a red tokin. She usually carries a camera.
key_facts: Writes, photographs, and hand-delivers the Bunbunmaru Newspaper across Gensokyo, embellishing incidents for maximum dramatic value.
One of the fastest flyers in Gensokyo, capable of commanding gale-force winds with her leaf fan and snapping photos mid-duel.
Outwardly friendly and inquisitive, yet bound to the strict hierarchical reporting chains of the Youkai Mountain tengu society.
personality: Brisk, polite, and performatively journalistic—frequently opening with 'Ayayaya!' while steering every conversation toward a scoop.

allies.name: Kosuzu Motoori
allies.summary: Aya and Kosuzu have become business partners in the selling of the Bunbunmaru Newspaper for the Human Village. Aya, a cunning journalist, sees Kosuzu as a source of information and a business partner, while Kosuzu, initially naive, gradually becomes a more willing participant in Aya's dealings.

allies.name: Kutaka Niwatari
allies.summary: Fellow resident and companion associated with Waterfall of Nine Heavens (九天の滝).

rivals.name: Momiji Inubashiri
rivals.summary: Momiji is a wolf tengu (and thus lower ranking) co-worker living on Youkai Mountain. She often gets in fights with Aya.

rivals.name: Hatate Himekaidou
rivals.summary: Hatate is a fellow crow tengu and rival newspaper journalist. Aya dislikes Hatate for being a shut-in that doesn't "try to contribute to society", while Hatate criticizes Aya for acting pompous about being busy all the time.

rivals.name: Mamizou Futatsuiwa
rivals.summary: Mamizou and Aya are shown as being quite underhanded with each other in a fiercely competitive rivalry, although they still find ways to call truces on occasion.

rivals.name: Sumireko Usami
rivals.summary: Aya goes to Kourindou tries to interview Sumireko for her new upcoming magazine, Bunbunharu Weekly, in the hopes of falsifying information to make Sumireko look like a threat to Gensokyo.

acquaintances.name: Reimu Hakurei
acquaintances.summary: Aya frequently visits Reimu and the Hakurei Shrine, being an ever potential source of interesting new articles, much to the latter's dismay. Despite this, Aya refuses to report on some of the incidents that Reimu solved, stating that she needs more evidence for her claims.

acquaintances.name: Megumu Iizunamaru
acquaintances.summary: Megumu is the chief of the crow tengu, which makes her Aya's superior. Aya attempts to do some whistleblowing and expose Megumu's manufactured red snow scheme, but gives up upon learning that doing so would only go against the "public interest" of Gensokyo.

title: Tsukumogami of an Aging Biwa
tagline: Tsukumogami of an Aging Biwa; Notable figure of Gensokyo
abilities: Making sounds and performing on her own

Benben fights (verbally) with her sister Yatsuhashi as to who'll get to attack the player and, depending on the shot type selected, she will fight the heroine or leave in search of another opponent (though it's important to note that she was under the effects of the Miracle Mallet at the time).
personality: Benben plays the role of the cool and grown-up older sister, in contrast with her little sister who is reckless and hot-blooded. However, they both dream of a utopia where tools could move freely without the need of youkai or humans using them.

allies.name: Yatsuhashi Tsukumo
allies.summary: Yatsuhashi is Benben's younger sister, and serves as a hot-headed, energetic counterpart to Benben's cool and collected demeanor. The two of them are both tsukumogami, so they are not technically related by blood; they call themselves sisters because they were both "born" at roughly the same time.

acquaintances.name: Raiko Horikawa
acquaintances.summary: Raiko Horikawa is a drum tsukumogami that approached her and Yatsuhashi, and offered to swap out their source of power.

acquaintances.name: Seija Kijin
acquaintances.summary: No dialogue is exchanged between these characters; when mentioned by the heroine, Seija appears to realize she's talking about tsukumogami, but no more than that. They all appear to share the same goal of overthrowing society.

acquaintances.name: Shinmyoumaru Sukuna
acquaintances.summary: No dialogue is exchanged between these characters; when mentioned by the heroine, Seija appears to realize she's talking about tsukumogami, but no more than that. They all appear to share the same goal of overthrowing society.

title: The Sealed Great Magician
tagline: Head priestess and founder of Myouren Temple; immortal Buddhist magician pursuing human-youkai coexistence
abilities: Magic (specialized in magic that increases her physical abilities)
theme_music: 感情の摩天楼　～ Cosmic Mind (Undefined Fantastic Object, Hopeless Masquerade, Urban Legend in Limbo)
first_appearance: Undefined Fantastic Object (Cover, Stage 6 Boss)
who_they_are: Byakuren Hijiri is a youkai magician and a Buddhist nun. Hijiri has the power to enhance her physical abilities and is over 1100 years old. She is the head of the Myouren Temple. She has impressive charisma but has a very questionable attitude with regards to her religion, yet is kind to both Youkai and Humans. Hijiri is disliked by humans and was once sealed by them. She is a vegetarian and allegedly dislikes fighting. She is tall, has long, wavy purple hair that fades to brown and hazel eyes. Hijiri wears a white dress and a black coat that crisscrosses over that dress, as well as black laced boots and a green bead necklace. Hijiri usually carries around the Sutra Scroll.
key_facts: Formerly sealed in Hokkai inside Makai for centuries before her followers freed her with the Palanquin Ship, now presiding over Myouren Temple.
Uses sutra magic exclusively to augment her own physical speed, strength, and senses to superhuman levels.
Welcomes both humans and peaceful youkai to study Buddhist precepts under the temple roof, maintaining strict bans on predation and alcohol within the grounds.
personality: Gentle, serene, and maternal, yet carries unyielding moral gravity when defending her disciples or temple sanctuary.

allies.name: Ichirin Kumoi
allies.summary: Ichirin Kumoi is a youkai who used to live at Byakuren's temple hundreds of years ago. By showing kindness to both her and Unzan, even though she was human, she earned their trust.

allies.name: Minamitsu Murasa
allies.summary: Byakuren saved Minamitsu Murasa from her grim fate of haunting the oceans and capsizing ships. Minamitsu became one of Byakuren's strongest allies, and she used the flying object in Gensokyo to retrieve the treasures needed to revive the nun.

allies.name: Shou Toramaru
allies.summary: Shou Toramaru was a disciple and avatar of Bishamonten who lived at Byakuren's temple. Byakuren had used her to gain more trust from the other youkai living on the mountain at the time, and in order to show her kindness towards youkai.

allies.name: Myouren Hijiri
allies.summary: She had a younger brother named Myouren Hijiri. However, her brother died.

allies.name: Koishi Komeiji
allies.summary: Byakuren believes that Koishi's present "thoughtless" state is close to enlightenment, and wants her to join the temple.

allies.name: Nazrin
allies.summary: Fellow resident and companion associated with Myouren Temple (命蓮寺).

rivals.name: Toyosatomimi no Miko
rivals.summary: Miko and Byakuren initially had an antagonistic relationship with one another, with Byakuren seeing her as a threat to the youkai, thus building her temple on top of the mausoleum to keep the former from resurrecting.

acquaintances.name: Nue Houjuu
acquaintances.summary: It is also known from both Touhou Hisoutensoku and Oriental Sacred Place that Nue Houjuu is currently living at the temple she built.

acquaintances.name: Mamizou Futatsuiwa
acquaintances.summary: It is also known from both Touhou Hisoutensoku and Oriental Sacred Place that Nue Houjuu is currently living at the temple she built.

acquaintances.name: Kyouko Kasodani
acquaintances.summary: Kyouko cleans the Myouren Temple.

acquaintances.name: Seiga Kaku
acquaintances.summary: While they have not been seen interacting, Byakuren is highly disturbed by Seiga's activities and claims that she can sense great evil from her.

acquaintances.name: Hata no Kokoro
acquaintances.summary: Kokoro stays at Myouren Temple in order to learn how to control her emotions in order to prevent another berserk at the end of Byakuren's storyline.

acquaintances.name: Joon Yorigami
acquaintances.summary: After Joon is defeated by Reimu and Yukari, Byakuren takes her under her wing to teach her a simpler lifestyle. However, she later escapes the temple and keeps stealing other people's possessions, but this time from those who can afford it.

title: Black Cat of Bad Omens
tagline: Bakeneko shikigami of Ran Yakumo
abilities: Use of sorcery (possessed as shikigami), Surprising People (as bakeneko)
theme_music: ティアオイエツォン(withered leaf) (Perfect Cherry Blossom)
first_appearance: Perfect Cherry Blossom (Stage 2 Midboss, Stage 2 Boss, Extra Midboss, Ran's Spell Card attack)
who_they_are: Chen is a bakeneko and shikigami of Ran Yakumo. She is more powerful at sorcery when near Ran Yakumo, but can only surprise people in her cat form. Chen is playful and childlike but unreliable. Chen has dark brown eyes, brown hair, and black cat ears with a gold earring in her left ear, and two cat tails. She wears a red dress with a white collar and gold trimming, light pink sleeves, white socks, and a green mob cap. She has long hot pink claws. Chen is rather short.
key_facts: A two-tailed bakeneko from Mayohiga who serves as Ran Yakumo's shikigami and runs errands for the Yakumo household.
Gains formidable speed and sorcery while wearing Ran's shikigami talismans, though water immediately breaks the possession state and reverts her to an ordinary cat youkai.
personality: Bright, energetic, and childlike; tries hard to sound mature when carrying out Ran-sama's instructions.

allies.name: Ran and Yukari
allies.summary: Ran Yakumo is her master and Yukari Yakumo is her master's master.

allies.name: Rin Kaenbyou
allies.summary: Chen and Rin appear to be very friendly and physically affectionate with each other, implying a close relationship between the two. Ran mentioned that the two of them play with each other often, implying they are currently friends.

allies.name: Ran Yakumo
allies.summary: Bakeneko shikigami of Ran Yakumo Chen is a bakeneko and shikigami of Ran Yakumo.

allies.name: Yukari Yakumo
allies.summary: Fellow resident and companion associated with Mayohiga (Yakumo Estate) (マヨヒガ).

title: The God of the Unowned
tagline: The God of the Unowned; Notable figure of Gensokyo
abilities: Capable of letting one relinquish ownership
theme_music: あの賑やかな市場は今どこに　〜 Immemorial Marketeers (Unconnected Marketeers)
first_appearance: Unconnected Marketeers (Stage 6 Boss, Reimu Good Ending, Sakuya Alternate Ending, Sanae Alternate Ending)
who_they_are: She seems to be singularly concerned with the rules and regulations governing marketplaces, and is highly irritated when they are broken. She accuses the protagonist of wanting to steal and monopolize the cards after she refuses to trade with her, and detests those that place the pursuit of profit over the rituals and regulations she favours.
personality: Chimata appears to be polite but somewhat full of herself and dramatic, making bold claims such as humanity being "unable to survive" without her, and immediately jumping to the conclusion that those who don't wish to trade must be criminals of some kind. She seems to be singularly concerned with the rules and regulations governing marketplaces, and is highly irritated when they are broken.

allies.name: Megumu Iizunamaru
allies.summary: Megumu was Chimata's would-be business partner in the creation of the Ability Card marketplace. Their relationship had always been strained, as Megumu had sought to only use Chimata's powers to further the interests of tengu society, and had dissolved into outright hostilities by the end of the Ability Card Incident.

allies.name: Tsukasa Kudamaki
allies.summary: Tsukasa is seemingly subordinate to Chimata, with Tsukasa addressing her politely. Tsukasa reports Megumu's betrayal to Chimata, but it appears likely that Tsukasa was playing both sides.

allies.name: Momoyo Himemushi
allies.summary: The two were also partners, although not much is known about their relationship. Since Momoyo and Megumu Iizunamaru are friends and neither Chimata nor Momoyo mention the other, they don't seem to be close and may have a similarly strained relationship.

allies.name: Mike Goutokuji
allies.summary: Participates in the marketplace festivals overseen by the god of markets, Chimata Tenkyuu.

rivals.name: Nitori Kawashiro
rivals.summary: Nitori is shown to have become something of a collaborator with Chimata during the events of 100th Black Market, with the pair working together to try and shut down the black market. Upon fighting Marisa Kirisame, Chimata sends her to go meet Nitori at Moriya Shrine, believing that she can help with the task.

acquaintances.name: Sakuya Izayoi
acquaintances.summary: Sakuya expresses that Remilia Scarlet wants to experience the market, but due to being a vampire she cannot be around a rainbow. Chimata explains that she can hold a market as long as a special event is happening, even if its not a rainbow.

title: Monster of Tainted Organic Material
tagline: Monster of Tainted Organic Material; Notable figure of Gensokyo
theme_music: Vampiric Cryptid Chupacabra (Unfinished Dream of All Living Ghost)
first_appearance: Unfinished Dream of All Living Ghost (Playable character, Possible Opponent)
who_they_are: This personality makes her a perfect match for Yuuma Toutetsu, whom she quickly becomes acquaintances with. She finds the Blood Pools a perfect home for herself, so much so that she is viewed as a recluse by underworld dwellers such as Rin, as she has not left the Blood Pools ever since she found it.
personality: Chiyari has a carefree attitude, mostly lazing around the Blood Pools and feeding off the resentment of the underworld dwellers. This personality makes her a perfect match for Yuuma Toutetsu, whom she quickly becomes acquaintances with. She finds the Blood Pools a perfect home for herself, so much so that she is viewed as a recluse by underworld dwellers such as Rin, as she has not left the Blood Pools ever since she found it.

allies.name: Rin Kaenbyou
allies.summary: Chiyari and Rin are fellow underworld dwellers and are on friendly terms. However, Rin disapproves of her association with Yuuma.

rivals.name: Mamizou Futatsuiwa
rivals.summary: Mamizou bullies Chiyari by purposefully nicknaming her a chupacabra. Mamizou then spreads this nickname throughout Gensokyo.

acquaintances.name: Zanmu Nippaku
acquaintances.summary: Chiyari and Zanmu knew each other back when Former Hell was known as Hell. Chiyari holds great admiration for Zanmu due to the resentment she caused for all the creatures left behind by moving Hell.

acquaintances.name: Yuuma Toutetsu
acquaintances.summary: Chiyari and Yuuma have similar laid back personalities and both reside in the Former Hell's Blood Pools. This makes them a perfect match and they hit off immediately.

acquaintances.name: Utsuho Reiuji
acquaintances.summary: Chiyari casually mentions how Utsuho was absent when passing the Remains of Blazing Hell. She uses Utsuho's nickname (Okuu) as she does with Rin, hinting a more informal relationship similar to Rin's.

acquaintances.name: Nazrin
acquaintances.summary: Chiyari calls Nazrin by the nickname "Naz", both having lived in Former Hell at the same time before the events of Undefined Fantastic Object, it hints at a more informal relationship between the two of them.

title: Resident of Fantasy That Runs Through Time
tagline: Resident of Fantasy That Runs Through Time; Assistant professor
theme_music: Sailor of Time (Phantasmagoria of Dim.Dream)
first_appearance: Phantasmagoria of Dim.Dream (Cover, Playable Character, Stage 8 Boss)
who_they_are: Chiyuri Kitashirakawa is a notable human figure of Gensokyo associated with Assistant professor.
personality: Known across Gensokyo for their distinctive presence and mastery of artificial magic.

allies.name: Maribel Hearn
allies.summary: Fellow resident and companion associated with Probability Space Hypervessel & Outside World Rift (可能性空間移動船・外の世界).

allies.name: Renko Usami
allies.summary: Fellow resident and companion associated with Probability Space Hypervessel & Outside World Rift (可能性空間移動船・外の世界).

allies.name: Sumireko Usami
allies.summary: Fellow resident and companion associated with Probability Space Hypervessel & Outside World Rift (可能性空間移動船・外の世界).

acquaintances.name: Yumemi Okazaki
acquaintances.summary: Yumemi is Chiyuri's senior and as such Chiyuri does several tasks in order to help her get her goals of collecting information for her research. However, both seem to have a more informal relationship, speaking to each other frankly and not having qualms in correcting each other (sometimes with force).

title: Fairy of the Ice
tagline: Ice fairy of Misty Lake and self-proclaimed strongest fairy in Gensokyo
theme_music: Tomboyish Girl in Love (Embodiment of Scarlet Devil, Touhou Hisoutensoku)
first_appearance: Embodiment of Scarlet Devil (Stage 2 Boss)
who_they_are: Cirno is an ice fairy living near Misty Lake. She has icicle wings, light blue hair, a blue dress, and the power to manipulate cold and freeze objects instantly. Cirno is loud, childish, proudly proclaims herself 'the strongest', and loves freezing frogs and picking danmaku fights.
key_facts: Radiates year-round cold around Misty Lake with six crystalline ice wings, capable of freezing water, projectiles, and small creatures on contact.
Leads the lakeside fairies around the southern shore and Crawdad Rock, frequently challenging travelers to Spell Card duels.
Enjoys freezing frogs and watching them revive in the water (roughly one in three shatters by accident), and takes immense pride in basic reading and arithmetic.
personality: Loud, boastful, and supremely confident; refers to herself as 'Eye' (Atai) in Japanese cadence and treats every minor victory as proof she is the Strongest.

allies.name: Three Fairies of Light
allies.summary: All of the members of Three Fairies of Light (Sunny Milk, Luna Child and Star Sapphire) are both friends and enemies of Cirno. This is due to them joining forces to make pranks since they met, but also declaring a "fairy war" against the ice fairy in Great Fairy Wars.

allies.name: Sakuya Izayoi
allies.summary: Sakuya has trouble understanding why Cirno finds freezing frogs or flowers fun, but at least came to understand fairies' recklessness from watching Cirno fight in Touhou Hisoutensoku. Cirno also affirmed not wanting to be a fairy maid.

allies.name: Wriggle Nightbug
allies.summary: Commands swarms of fireflies, beetles, and venomous insects, often hanging around with Rumia, Mystia, and Cirno.

rivals.name: Lily White
rivals.summary: Frequent springtime rival among the fairies whenever Lily White’s herald of spring clashes with Cirno’s frost.

acquaintances.name: Eternity Larva
acquaintances.summary: Eternity and Cirno are implied to have known each other before the events of Hidden Star in Four Seasons. Eternity notices Cirno's tan before they fight to see who the summer belongs to.

acquaintances.name: Daiyousei
acquaintances.summary: Daiyousei is first seen (presumably) associated with Cirno Chapter 13 when both of them were playing hide and seek. After meeting and talking with the Three Fairies of Light, Cirno appears to have completely forgotten about Daiyousei.

acquaintances.name: Letty Whiterock
acquaintances.summary: Nothing is known about Cirno's relationship with Letty Whiterock. She appears to dislike being grouped up with her as she explains her superiority when interviewed by Aya Shameimaru.

acquaintances.name: Reimu Hakurei
acquaintances.summary: Reimu Hakurei is one of Cirno's targets for her pranks and Great Fairy Wars.

acquaintances.name: Giant Toad
acquaintances.summary: The Giant Toad is a toad that once ate Cirno because she was freezing all the other toads.

title: Fairy of Hell
tagline: Hell fairy and subordinate of Hecatia Lapislazuli living beneath the Hakurei Shrine
theme_music: Pierrot of the Star-Spangled Banner (Legacy of Lunatic Kingdom)
first_appearance: Legacy of Lunatic Kingdom (Stage 5 Boss)
who_they_are: Clownpiece is a lampad fairy living in Hell. Clownpiece has the power to make others go insane if they look into the light of her purple torch. Clownpiece is a stronger than average fairy. She is playful, mischievous, childish, and a bit dumb. Clownpiece is a servant of Hecatia. She lives in a cave below the Hakurei Shrine. Clownpiece has long blonde hair, pink eyes, and a pair of fairy wings. She wears a bodysuit patterned like the US flag, a frilly pink collar and a purple jester's hat.
key_facts: A lampad fairy from Hell whose torchlight drives mortals toward madness by amplifying inner chaos, now residing in the undercroft beneath the Hakurei Shrine.

allies.summary: Keine's article states that Keine Kamishirasawa has a close relation with the Hieda family, and Keine uses their records for her lessons. It also reveals Akyuu is not a student at Keine's school.

allies.name: Kosuzu Motoori
allies.summary: Due to their shared interest in books, Akyuu and Kosuzu Motoori appear to be close friends - Akyuu frequently visits Suzunaan to borrow books, both from the Outside World and demon books and the two speak far more casually when in each other's company.

allies.name: Mononobe no Futo
allies.summary: The Shikaisen from Ancient Japan; Notable figure of Gensokyo Hieda no Akyuu points out that because of it, she has an extremely "hermit-like" personality.

acquaintances.name: Yukari Yakumo
acquaintances.summary: Akyuu and Yukari Yakumo "first met" in Memorizable Gensokyo, though their mannerisms imply that they've known each other in Akyuu's previous lives (possibly as early as Hieda no Aichi 1,200 years ago).

acquaintances.name: Reimu Hakurei
acquaintances.summary: The Hakurei clan and Hieda clan appear to have some relations, as the Hakurei Shrine volunteered to hold a party in 1994 when Hieda no Akyuu was born in the Bunbunmaru newspaper article of her birth.

title: The Hidden God Nagashi-bina
tagline: The Hidden God Nagashi-bina; Chasing away lost humans, gathering the misfortune of humans
occupation: Chasing away lost humans, gathering the misfortune of humans
theme_music: Dark Side of Fate (Mountain of Faith)
first_appearance: Mountain of Faith (Stage 2 Midboss, Stage 2 Boss)
who_they_are: She considers herself a friend among humans and often tries to help them by scaring them away from the mountain or carrying their misfortune to the gods. Such as when she tries to warn Reimu or Marisa that going up the mountain is dangerous when they are first in the Great Youkai Forest. Hina cares a lot about the environment and will turn objects of misfortune that float down the river into Nagashibina to remove their misfortune.
personality: Hina's personality is typically friendly and sociable. She considers herself a friend among humans and often tries to help them by scaring them away from the mountain or carrying their misfortune to the gods. Such as when she tries to warn Reimu or Marisa that going up the mountain is dangerous when they are first in the Great Youkai Forest.

allies.name: Takane Yamashiro
allies.summary: Fellow resident and companion associated with Great Youkai Forest (大妖怪の森).

title: Beautiful Stalker of Hell
tagline: Beautiful Stalker of Hell; Lure people into Hell
abilities: Never letting anything slip from her grasp
theme_music: The Path to Yomi Where None Turn Back (Unfinished Dream of All Living Ghost)
first_appearance: Unfinished Dream of All Living Ghost (Playable Character, Possible Opponent)
who_they_are: For one, her one-sided obsessiveness towards Zanmu Nippaku. She goes on to stalk her on whatever chance she gets and tries to please her when nearby. She is also somewhat of a masochist when dealing with Zanmu.
personality: Hisami has a very eerie demeanour that betrays her otherwise captivating appearance. For one, her one-sided obsessiveness towards Zanmu Nippaku. She goes on to stalk her on whatever chance she gets and tries to please her when nearby.

allies.name: Zanmu Nippaku
allies.summary: Hisami is Zanmu's assistant, carrying out orders and bringing people to her. Hisami treats Zanmu with a deep respect, calling her "Lady Zanmu" and even "Her Greatness" However, her relation goes beyond as Hisami has a one-way infatuation with Zanmu, and she tries her best to gain Zanmu's attention.

allies.name: Clownpiece
allies.summary: Fellow resident and companion associated with New Hell (地獄).

allies.name: Hecatia Lapislazuli
allies.summary: Fellow resident and companion associated with New Hell (地獄).

title: Chinese Girl
tagline: Chinese youkai martial artist, gatekeeper, and head gardener of the Scarlet Devil Mansion
occupation: Gatekeeper and Gardener of the Scarlet Devil Mansion
theme_music: Shanghai Alice of Meiji 17 (Embodiment of Scarlet Devil)
first_appearance: Embodiment of Scarlet Devil (Stage 3 Midboss, Stage 3 Boss)
who_they_are: Hong Meiling is the gatekeeper and gardener of the Scarlet Devil Mansion. Tall, red-haired, and athletic in a green Chinese martial arts dress and beret, she can manipulate Qi and practices martial arts. While pleasant, cheerful, and notorious for napping on duty, she is physically formidable and much more competent than her sleepy reputation suggests. At the mansion gate she serves as the first filter: warm to invited guests, firm with suspicious visitors, and devastatingly swift if someone attempts to force entry.
key_facts: Guards the red iron front gate of the Scarlet Devil Mansion and tends its extensive rose beds and landscaped grounds.
Master of Bajiquan and Taijiquan who manipulates rainbow-colored qi (vital energy) in close combat and danmaku.
Practices morning tai chi on the courtyard gravel, occasionally dozes off during quiet midday shifts, and serves as the most approachable member of the mansion staff.
personality: Warm, relaxed, and conversational by default, dropping instantly into grounded martial focus if someone attempts to force the gate.

allies.name: Remilia Scarlet
allies.summary: Remilia is Meiling's mistress. Being the type of person Remilia is, she tends to tease all her subordinates and Meiling is no exception.

allies.name: Patchouli Knowledge
allies.summary: Patchouli is the friend of her mistress and sometimes berates her for not thinking enough and spending too much time reading senseless comics.

allies.name: Flandre Scarlet
allies.summary: Flandre is Remilia's younger sister. It's unknown what kind of relationship Meiling and Flandre have, as they were seen interacting in only a brief incident.

allies.name: Koakuma
allies.summary: Fellow resident and companion associated with Scarlet Devil Mansion (紅魔館).

rivals.name: Taisui Xingjun and the giant catfish
rivals.summary: Taisui Xingjun is Meiling's sworn enemy and the Giant Catfish is the avatar of Taisui Xingjun. They both only appeared in her dream while she was reading a manga so any realistic communications with them (and whether they even exist outside the dream) are currently unknown

acquaintances.name: Sakuya Izayoi
acquaintances.summary: Sakuya is a fellow employee of Meiling. Meiling's win quote against Sakuya in Touhou Hisoutensoku implies a friendly, if somewhat formal, relationship between the two of them.

acquaintances.name: Fairy maids and other staff
acquaintances.summary: The fairy maids assist Meiling, but it's unknown what sort of authority she has over the fairy maids in the mansion. Perfect Memento in Strict Sense implies that youkai also join in Meiling's battles on a whim but instead usually only point and laugh.

title: The Great Wheel
tagline: The Great Wheel; Guardian of the Palanquin Ship
theme_music: The Traditional Old Man and the Stylish Girl (Undefined Fantastic Object, Hopeless Masquerade, Urban Legend in Limbo)
first_appearance: Undefined Fantastic Object (Stage 3 Supporting Midboss, Stage 3 Supporting Boss)
who_they_are: She is shown getting along well with nearly everyone she interacts with, and generally has a good nature. Despite this, she is quick to fight and has a bit of a mean streak, happily disciplining disciples during training. However, she herself is also prone to bending the rules of her training.
personality: Ichirin is described as having a pleasant personality while also being quite tenacious. She is shown getting along well with nearly everyone she interacts with, and generally has a good nature. Despite this, she is quick to fight and has a bit of a mean streak, happily disciplining disciples during training.

allies.name: Byakuren Hijiri
allies.summary: Ichirin is a devout follower of Byakuren, who showed kindness not only towards her but towards Unzan as well. As much as Ichirin respects her, she might sometimes disobey her if something piques her curiosity.

allies.name: Minamitsu Murasa
allies.summary: She is also part of Minamitsu Murasas group of youkai. She is shown as close friends with Murasa, and they can be seen together frequently.

allies.name: Shou Toramaru
allies.summary: She is also part of Minamitsu Murasas group of youkai. She is shown as close friends with Murasa, and they can be seen together frequently.

allies.name: Nazrin
allies.summary: She is also part of Minamitsu Murasas group of youkai. She is shown as close friends with Murasa, and they can be seen together frequently.

allies.name: Kyouko Kasodani
allies.summary: Fellow resident and companion associated with Myouren Temple (命蓮寺).

allies.summary: Fellow resident and companion associated with Myouren Temple (命蓮寺).

allies.name: Nue Houjuu
allies.summary: Fellow resident and companion associated with Myouren Temple (命蓮寺).

rivals.name: Mononobe no Futo
rivals.summary: Ichirin and Futo have a rivalry with each other thanks to their clashing religious beliefs. Despite this, the two work shockingly well together, able to prove themselves to both Byakuren and Toyosatomimi no Miko The two got along rather well, but had a falling out after being defeated by Joon Yorigami.

acquaintances.name: Unzan
acquaintances.summary: As the Guarded, she is Unzan's handler and he is her protector. He is devoted to watching over her.

title: Beautiful Scarlet Cloth
tagline: Beautiful Scarlet Cloth; Messenger of the Dragon Palace
theme_music: 黒い海に紅く　～ Legendary Fish (Scarlet Weather Rhapsody)
first_appearance: Scarlet Weather Rhapsody (Playable Character, Possible Opponent)
who_they_are: The only exception is Tenshi Hinanawi, due to her egoistic attitude and the concern she has seeing her reports, which really worries and irritates Iku. As a messenger of the Dragon Palace, she sends information from the palace to other people. It's said that she is lazy and as a result, she never takes upon the position of a leader because she only observes what other people do.
personality: Iku is a laid-back youkai that never shows interest in other people. The only exception is Tenshi Hinanawi, due to her egoistic attitude and the concern she has seeing her reports, which really worries and irritates Iku. As a messenger of the Dragon Palace, she sends information from the palace to other people.

rivals.name: Scarlet Weather Rhapsody
rivals.summary: Everyone attacked Iku either for no reason (sometimes twice) or because they suspected her of being the cause of the incidents, leaving the oarfish confused.

acquaintances.name: Tenshi Hinanawi
acquaintances.summary: Iku comments to Tenshi that she was supposed to file a report before warning everyone about the earthquake, but couldn't because all of the Hinanawi clan were away from their homes.

acquaintances.name: Suika Ibuki
acquaintances.summary: Iku first encounters Suika when Suika's climbing to Heaven to see Tenshi Hinanawi, where she tested Suika before allowing Suika to move on. Suika won, surprising Iku with her power.

title: Unknown
tagline: Unknown; Notable figure of Gensokyo
first_appearance: Touhou Project Canon
who_they_are: She doesn't even care much for her own older sister, using her as a tool and belittling her. She takes pride and satisfaction in being called one of Gensokyo's most hated residents. She's a spendthrift who can never maintain her wealth as she's always making impulsive and extravagant purchases.
personality: Joon is a remorseless thief who has no issue with using her ability to rob anybody of their wealth, having no concern for their wellbeing. She doesn't even care much for her own older sister, using her as a tool and belittling her. She takes pride and satisfaction in being called one of Gensokyo's most hated residents.

allies.name: Shion Yorigami
allies.summary: Shion is Joon's older sister.

acquaintances.name: Byakuren Hijiri
acquaintances.summary: After Joon is defeated by Reimu and Yukari, Byakuren takes her under her wing to teach her a simpler lifestyle. However, she later escapes the temple and keeps stealing other people's possessions, but this time from those who can afford it.

title: Unfulfilled Grudge
tagline: Unfulfilled Grudge; Notable figure of Gensokyo
theme_music: Pure Furies ~ Whereabouts of the Heart (Legacy of Lunatic Kingdom)
first_appearance: Legacy of Lunatic Kingdom (Final Boss, Extra Stage Co-Boss)
who_they_are: Her hatred is strong enough to persist after she murders Hou'yi, her first grudge and the person responsible for her son's death, to the point where she currently targets all of her animosity towards Chang'e and the Lunarians despite having nothing to do with her son's death. Junko doesn't seem to care for intricateness, preferring to do things with a straightforward attitude.
personality: As a Sagacious Spirit who has purified her grudge towards Chang'e, Junko is described to be a being made out of pure fury. Her hatred is strong enough to persist after she murders Hou'yi, her first grudge and the person responsible for her son's death, to the point where she currently targets all of her animosity towards Chang'e and the Lunarians despite having nothing to do with her son's death.

allies.name: Hecatia Lapislazuli
allies.summary: Junko and Hecatia are friends. Because Hecatia sympathized with Junko, she accompanied her in her plot against the Lunar Capital, lending Junko her powers, as well as fairies like Clownpiece.

allies.name: Ringo
allies.summary: Fellow resident and companion associated with Sea of Tranquility (The Moon) (静かの海・月面).

allies.name: Seiran
allies.summary: Fellow resident and companion associated with Sea of Tranquility (The Moon) (静かの海・月面).

rivals.name: Chang'e
rivals.summary: Junko has a grudge against Chang'e, because Chang'e's husband was responsible for killing Junko's son. So, she plotted against the Lunar Capital and staged an invasion to get to Chang'e.

rivals.name: Hou'yi
rivals.summary: Hou'yi was both Chang'e and Junko's husband, though its unknown if they were both married to him at the same time. Hou'yi was the one who murdered Junko's son, which caused Junko to kill him in retaliation.

rivals.name: Sagume Kishin
rivals.summary: Commander of the Lunar Defense Corps opposing Junko and Hecatia Lapislazuli’s siege of the Lunar Capital.

acquaintances.name: Clownpiece
acquaintances.summary: Hecatia loaned Clownpiece to Junko to use as she wished. Clownpiece was purified into pure lifeforce and simply told to do what fairies do and play around near the Lunar Capital, at the Sea of Tranquility.

title: The Bamboo Forest's Loup-Garou
tagline: Honshu wolf-woman (werewolf) of the Bamboo Forest of the Lost and member of the Grassroots Youkai Network
abilities: Can transform into a wolf on the night of the full moon
theme_music: Lonesome Werewolf (Double Dealing Character)
first_appearance: Double Dealing Character (Stage 3 Midboss, Stage 3 Boss)
who_they_are: Kagerou Imaizumi is a Honshu werewolf. Kagerou can turn into a honshu wolf or into her werewolf form on full moon nights. She lives in the Bamboo Forest of the Lost. She has a calm and relaxed personality even as a werewolf. Kagerou is good friends with Sekibanki and Wakasagihime and is part of the Grassroots Youkai Network. Kagerou has long auburn hair, red eyes, and wolf ears and a wolf tail. She wears a white dress with a large red crescent moon design and black trimming. She has a red amulet and long, sharp red fingernails. Moonlight makes Kagerou's exposed skin turn hairy.
key_facts: A polite, calm werewolf who lives in the Bamboo Forest of the Lost, grows thick body hair on the night of the full moon, and socializes with Wakasagihime and Sekibanki.
personality: Courteous, self-conscious about her fur and claws, and surprisingly gentle despite her ferocious self-introductions.

allies.name: Sekibanki
allies.summary: Kagerou is good friends with Sekibanki and Wakasagihime and is part of the Grassroots Youkai Network.

acquaintances.name: Wakasagihime
acquaintances.summary: Kagerou knows Wakasagihime thanks to the Grassroots Youkai Network, where she seems to know Wakasagihime's general personality. Kagerou stated that she once tried to eat Wakasagihime by mistake.

acquaintances.name: Rinnosuke Morichika
acquaintances.summary: Rinnosuke teaches Kagerou about a game called "Are you a human?" when she asks Rinnosuke for an advice to have someone to chat in her free time.

title: Eternal Princess
tagline: Exiled Lunarian princess, mistress of Eientei, and manipulator of eternity and the instantaneous
occupation: Mistress of Eientei, formerly a princess of the Lunar Capital
abilities: Manipulation of eternity and the instantaneous
age: Ageless, existed for at least 1,300 years. Stated by ZUN to be hundreds of millions of yea
theme_music: 竹取飛翔　～ Lunatic Princess (Imperishable Night)
first_appearance: Imperishable Night (Cover, FinalB Boss)
who_they_are: Kaguya Houraisan is a Lunarian princess. She is immortal and incredibly ancient. Kaguya has the power to manipulate "eternity" and "the instantaneous". She lives in Eientei with Eirin and Reisen who serve her. She is refined and carefree but lazy and haughty, even bratty. She enjoys fighting Mokou and regularly kills her. Kaguya has dark brown eyes and extremely long black hair. Kaguya wears a pink shirt with many white bows and a long dark red skirt decorated with gold flower and bamboo shapes.
key_facts: The historical Bamboo Cutter's Princess who drank the forbidden Hourai Elixir and now resides in Eientei deep within the Bamboo Forest of the Lost.
Can manipulate eternity (preserving anything unchanged against time or decay) and the instantaneous (acting within hidden fractions of time).
Keeps the Five Impossible Requests as treasured artifacts, tends bonsai in Eientei's courtyard, and regularly battles Fujiwara no Mokou to the death for mutual entertainment.
personality: Graceful, classical court diction layered over playful, bored mischief; loves proposing impossible errands or riddles just to watch mortals react.

allies.name: Eirin Yagokoro
allies.summary: Eirin is Kaguya's servant and friend. She is also the one who made the Hourai Elixir for Kaguya, and when sent to Earth to bring her back on the Moon, she killed the other emissaries and helped Kaguya hide herself.

allies.name: Reisen Udongein Inaba
allies.summary: Reisen is loyal to Kaguya, and Kaguya has been shown to be caring of her as seen in the endings of Imperishable Night and Legacy of Lunatic Kingdom. Despite their good relations, Reisen often ends up being chastised by both Kaguya and Eirin for her mistakes.

rivals.name: Fujiwara no Mokou
rivals.summary: Mokou and Kaguya seem to have a mutual rivalry. The two fight, compete, and even kill each other for fun and to alleviate the boredom of eternal life.

acquaintances.name: Tewi Inaba
acquaintances.summary: In return for letting her live on the land, Kaguya and Eirin freely give her information and technology. They also work in tandem with each other on certain plans such as ones shown.

title: The Avatar of Mountains and Lakes
tagline: The Avatar of Mountains and Lakes; Goddess of Moriya Shrine
species: Goddess of wind and rain (Divine Spirit)
theme_music: 神さびた古戦場　～ Suwa Foughten Field (Mountain of Faith)
first_appearance: Mountain of Faith (Cover, Stage 6 Boss, Extra Midboss)
who_they_are: She has a natural presence that can seem intimidating or suspicious at times, but also reliable. Unusually for a god she has little respect for tradition - she demands little formality in her worship, and encourages scientific progress. It is somewhat strange for a deity to be knowledgeable and interested about science.
personality: Kanako is an ambitious woman who treats religion like a business, using whatever means bring her the most "profit" - that profit being faith. She has a natural presence that can seem intimidating or suspicious at times, but also reliable. Unusually for a god she has little respect for tradition - she demands little formality in her worship, and encourages scientific progress.

allies.name: Suwako Moriya
allies.summary: Kanako and Suwako are the opposing gods of Moriya Shrine, but their profiles state that they share quite a few common interests and are actually pretty good friends. They do argue a lot, though, and Kanako still wears the snake-representing shimenawa to boast about the fact that she beat her.

allies.name: Yuiman Asama
allies.summary: Kanako claims to know Yuiman from before, and calls her a 'old friend', before she was brainwashed by the Lunarians as a goddess of her hometown and wishes she gets liberated from the Lunarian's control. Recently, Yuiman has been doing visits to the Moriya Shrine and to Kanako.

acquaintances.name: Sanae Kochiya
acquaintances.summary: Sanae is a wind priestess that worships Kanako, and was part of the shrine's move to Gensokyo. Kanako mentioned that Sanae herself can be referred to as one of the "gods" of the Moriya Shrine.

acquaintances.name: Utsuho Reiuji
acquaintances.summary: Kanako is the one who originally gave Utsuho her powers for her own end. At the moment it seems she is keeping Utsuho working to produce nuclear energy underground in Former Hell.

title: The One-Armed
tagline: One-armed horned hermit of Youkai Mountain, disguised Oni (Ibaraki-douji), and one of the Sages of Gensokyo
theme_music: Battlefield of the Flower Threshold (Urban Legend in Limbo, Antinomy of Common Flowers)
first_appearance: Urban Legend in Limbo (Playable Character, Possible Opponent)
who_they_are: Kasen Ibaraki is an oni hermit. Kasen has the power to guide animals and befriend them while her artificial right arm can crush vengeful spirits. She also immense physical strength. Kasen is one of the Sages of Gensokyo. She is polite to all but rather preachy. She lives on the Youkai Mountain. Kasen has pink eyes and shoulder length pink hair with Chinese-style buns and has a right arm made of smoke wrapped in bandages. Kasen wears a white top, green skirt, a maroon tabard, maroon slippers, and a shackle on her left wrist. She carries the Ibaraki Box of a Hundred Medicines. Her true right arm can turn her into Ibaraki-Douji.
key_facts: One of the original Sages of Gensokyo alongside Yukari Yakumo and Okina Matara, concealing her true oni heritage behind the persona of a virtuous mountain hermit.
Commanded by a bandaged prosthetic right arm formed of black smoke, guides animals (eagles, tigers, dragons), and frequently visits the Hakurei Shrine to lecture Reimu.
personality: Didactic, dignified, and motherly when lecturing on virtue or shrine upkeep, with a sharp, ancient weight surfacing whenever barrier threats or oni lore arise.

allies.name: Mamizou Futatsuiwa
allies.summary: At first Mamizou tries to get proofs about Kasen being an oni with the intention of having some sort of influence over the Hakurei Shrine, and tries to scare her away with a drinking contest, but she is tricked by the oni. However, Kasen invites the tanuki to hold a real drinking contest some day.

allies.name: Sumireko Usami
allies.summary: Kasen expresses resentment that Sumireko views youkai with such a casual and playful attitude, feeling that Sumireko should show youkai more respect. Despite that, it's shown that Kasen has grown a bit softer on her in more recent times.

rivals.name: Reimu Hakurei
rivals.summary: Kasen remembers Reimu Hakurei from long before, having visited the Hakurei Shrine many times in the past, although Reimu's memory failed her and she had to be reminded who Kasen was. She's mostly earned Reimu's annoyance, who dislikes sermons and doesn't want her shrine to smell of them.

rivals.name: Suika Ibuki
rivals.summary: When Suika Ibuki appeared at the Hakurei Shrine, Kasen quickly fled the scene in order to avoid her. She appears familiar with Suika, but her relationship with her is unknown, and she appears hesitant about letting Suika know about her current status.

rivals.name: Yuugi Hoshiguma
rivals.summary: When Suika Ibuki appeared at the Hakurei Shrine, Kasen quickly fled the scene in order to avoid her. She appears familiar with Suika, but her relationship with her is unknown, and she appears hesitant about letting Suika know about her current status.

acquaintances.name: Marisa Kirisame
acquaintances.summary: Initially thinking she was just a strange hermit, Marisa Kirisame also met Kasen some time before Wild and Horned Hermit and is the first to remember who she was. Once reunited, Kasen is invited by Marisa to visit more often, to the disdain of Reimu.

acquaintances.name: Kasen's Pets
acquaintances.summary: Kasen's pets include Koutei, Kume, Mukou, Kanda, and Houso. They're mostly cryptids who can be summoned at any time, such as when she called on the child dragon to abduct Reimu and used the dapeng for transportation.

acquaintances.name: Ibaraki-douji's Arm
acquaintances.summary: This is Kasen's right arm, cut off with the use of Onikirimaru long ago after all Kasen's malevolence was moved to it. Ibaraki's arm is sentient and has a mind of her own to the point where she can be considered a separate entity of sorts even after the two are re-combined.

acquaintances.name: Komachi Onozuka
acquaintances.summary: Initially Komachi Onozuka and Kasen are slightly antagonistic toward each other. Ordered to keep Kasen under surveillance, Komachi is distrusting of her, even to the point of threatening her with her scythe – although the death god doesn't appear to be serious about it.

acquaintances.name: Yukari Yakumo
acquaintances.summary: It is unknown how long Yukari and Kasen have known each other, but both are youkai sages. The monologue states it was the youkai sages who proposed the Hakurei Barrier, so Yukari and Kasen probably knew each other since at least that time.

acquaintances.name: Okina Matara
acquaintances.summary: Kasen has known Okina since a while back as a fellow sage, and commented how it was a misfortune getting to know her. She also claims to know how Okina works and acts around others, but any actual interaction has not been shown.

title: The Sculptor God Crafted by Utter Isolation
tagline: The Sculptor God Crafted by Utter Isolation; Notable figure of Gensokyo
theme_music: 偶像に世界を委ねて 〜 Idoratrize world (Wily Beast and Weakest Creature)
first_appearance: Wily Beast and Weakest Creature (Stage 6 Boss)
who_they_are: On one hand, at first, she tries to convince the protagonist that fighting her would be against their interests. On the other hand, she also boasts of thinking no one was left to defeat her in battle and is quick to engage the possessed protagonist once finding out about the animal spirit's plan to invade and relinquish her control over the Primate Spirit Garden.
personality: Keiki is quite polite and doesn't fight if she can avoid it, but this attitude presented seems to mostly extend to only humans. On one hand, at first, she tries to convince the protagonist that fighting her would be against their interests.

rivals.name: Yachie Kicchou
rivals.summary: Keiki looks down on animal spirits and titles all three options with insults - Keiga (strong-teeth) have more teeth than brains, Kiketsu (onimeisters) stink, and the Gouyoku (festive spirits) have no abilities other than pride.

rivals.name: Saki Kurokoma
rivals.summary: Keiki does not mention Saki in her dialogue, as Saki is introduced after Keiki. However, Saki admires the goddess's strength, despite their mutual rivalry.

acquaintances.name: Mayumi Joutouguu
acquaintances.summary: Mayumi was pottered by Keiki as the leader of her Haniwa army. She doesn't talk about her creation in her dialogues, but since Mayumi is clearly more elaborate and human-like than the idols they both use in their battles, Keiki seems to have made an effort with her.

acquaintances.name: Reimu Hakurei
acquaintances.summary: Keiki acts friendly towards the protagonists in the endings, and offers to craft a goshintai for the Hakurei god and a figure of Marisa. Marisa appears to have a positive opinion about Keiki, as she isn't sure why the beast spirits hate her, and visits her domain after the events of the game.

acquaintances.name: Marisa Kirisame
acquaintances.summary: Keiki acts friendly towards the protagonists in the endings, and offers to craft a goshintai for the Hakurei god and a figure of Marisa. Marisa appears to have a positive opinion about Keiki, as she isn't sure why the beast spirits hate her, and visits her domain after the events of the game.

title: History-Eating Half Beast
tagline: Schoolteacher, historian, and guardian of the Human Village; were-hakutaku who manipulates history
occupation: Schoolteacher at Hieda Temple School; acts as guardian of the human village
abilities: Eating history (as a human), Creating history (as a hakutaku)
theme_music: Plain Asia (Imperishable Night)
first_appearance: Imperishable Night (Stage 3 Midboss, Stage 3 Boss, Extra Midboss)
who_they_are: Keine Kamishirasawa is a were-hakutaku. She has the power to create history as a human and eat history as a hakutaku. Keine is a teacher and guardian of the Human Village. She is friendly with humans but not youkai and hides her youkai identity. Keine is friends with Mokou. Keine is tall and has silvery blue hair and brown eyes as a human; but silvery green hair and red eyes when in her hakutaku form. Keine wears a blue dress over a white frilly skirt, and a blue hat with a very large red ribbon. In her Hakutaku form, she has horns with a red bow on the left one, and her dress is green.
key_facts: Runs the terakoya (temple schoolhouse) in the Human Village, teaching reading, arithmetic, and history while compiling historical records alongside the Hieda family.

In human form she can 'eat' (conceal) existing history—making the entire Human Village invisible to attacking youkai during emergencies; under a full moon she transforms into a horned hakutaku capable of creating history.
Protects village residents, mediates human-youkai disputes within the palisade, and shares a close personal bond with Fujiwara no Mokou.
personality: Composed, articulate educator's cadence; patient with honest ignorance, stern with recklessness, and fiercely protective of her students and village.

who_they_are: Kogasa Tatara is a karakasa obake. She loves to scare humans by surprising them but has no special ability. Kogasa is known to be cheery but is easily frustrated in the face of failure (which is often). Kogasa is a talented blacksmith. She can often be found trying to scare people in the Myouren Temple Cemetery. Kogasa has teal hair, her right eye is teal and her left is red. She wears a teal vest with white sleeves a light blue skirt and geta sandals. She carries a traditional paper umbrella that has an eye and a mouth.
key_facts: Born from a forgotten violet-blue umbrella blown away in the wind, she sustains herself by surprising humans around Myouren Temple Cemetery and the Human Village.
Despite her goofy umbrella form, her surname recalls traditional *tatara* ironmaking: she is an accomplished blacksmith capable of forging and repairing fine steel blades, needles, and tools.

allies.name: Yuki

title: The Bake-danuki with Ten Transformations
tagline: Elder bake-danuki from Sado Island, shape-shifting advisor at Myouren Temple, and human-disguised regular in the Human Village
theme_music: Futatsuiwa from Sado (Ten Desires, Hopeless Masquerade, Unfinished Dream of All Living Ghost)
first_appearance: Ten Desires (Extra Boss)
who_they_are: Mamizou Futatsuiwa is a bake-danuki. She can disguise herself or things around her. Mamizou is mischievous but good-natured and quite responsible. She lives in the Tanuki Forest, is a guest of the Myouren Temple and a friend of Nue. She lends money to poor humans. Mamizou has brown eyes, light brown shoulder-length hair, tanuki ears, and a giant, fluffy striped tail. She wears a green leaf on her head, and glasses. Mamizou wears a pink shirt with a leather apron, a skirt striped like her tail, and carries a bottle of sake.
key_facts: Summoned from the Outside World by Nue Houjuu to bolster Myouren Temple, she commands high-tier transformation magic capable of disguising objects, animals, or herself.
Frequently walks the Human Village in human disguise, loitering near Suzunaan or Geidontei to observe village politics and mentor younger youkai like Kosuzu and Kokoro.
personality: Old-fashioned, gravelly elder dialect ('~ja', '~nou'); wry, worldly, and fond of testing young humans and youkai with pointed riddles.

rivals.name: Aya Shameimaru
rivals.summary: Mamizou and Aya started to have a back and forth rivalry after Aya wrote negatively of the tanuki in her newspaper. Subsequently, this rivalry has become a friendly one by the time of Lotus Eaters, where they have become drinking partners at Geidontei alongside Suika Ibuki.

rivals.name: Miyoi Okunoda
rivals.summary: Mamizou was originally hostile to Miyoi, demanding her to leave Geidontei with the threat of revealing her status as a youkai, however this was, in fact, a ploy made by both her and Suika to ensure that they could hang out at the pub on afterhours. Afterwards, Mamizou frequently visits the pub as a customer.

rivals.name: Chiyari Tenkajin
rivals.summary: Mamizou bullies Chiyari by purposefully nicknaming her a chupacabra. Mamizou then spreads this nickname throughout Gensokyo.

acquaintances.name: Kasen Ibaraki
acquaintances.summary: Kasen and Mamizou first meet at winter after the events of Ten Desires during an incident where a mysterious black mist was attacking the residents of Myouren Temple, which resulted to be Suika Ibuki.

acquaintances.name: Hata no Kokoro
acquaintances.summary: At the end of Mamizou's storyline, she urged Hata no Kokoro to, through battle with other characters in the game, learn how to control her emotions and to "discover herself" instead of becoming a mere tsukumogami for Sarugaku masks.

acquaintances.name: Kosuzu Motoori
acquaintances.summary: Mamizou became a regular customer of Kosuzu Motoori with an interest in the Demon books, and talks with Kosuzu warmly. By the end of the manga, Mamizou becomes quite protective of Kosuzu, going so far as to protect her from the "old school" youkai she happens upon.

name_jp: マエリベリー・ハーン

Even unconsciously, she enters "otherworlds" in her dreams, and is able to bring back items from them.
personality: Known across Gensokyo for their distinctive presence and mastery of seeing boundaries.

allies.name: Renko Usami
allies.summary: Renko Usami is the only other member of Maribel's Hifuu Club and a fellow student at Maribel's university.

allies.name: Sakuya Izayoi
allies.summary: In one of her dreams, Maribel met a maid at a mansion that was a deep scarlet. The details of the meeting are unknown, but it must have been a friendly one given that Maribel was allowed to take some cookies home with her.

allies.name: Fujiwara no Mokou
allies.summary: In another one of her dreams, Maribel is rescued from a mouse or rabbit youkai by a mysterious girl surrounded by flames in the shape of a phoenix. Afraid of the girl, Maribel ran away.

acquaintances.summary: When ZUN was asked about Yukari's and Maribel's relationship in a high school open lecture, he did not say much beyond mentioning Lafcadio Hearn's name and laughing.

acquaintances.name: Yuyuko Saigyouji
acquaintances.summary: Maribel encountered Yuyuko while investigating a supernatural hot spot (actually a place where ghosts come to the Outside World to play). Merry didn't display any indication that she could see Yuyuko, though she appeared to feel a chill from her presence.

title: Oriental Western Magician
tagline: Human ordinary magician of the Forest of Magic, incident resolver, and collector of grimoires and mushrooms
occupation: Magician, Kirisame Magic Shop owner, burglar, youkai exterminator, and incident solver
abilities: Using magic (Specialized in light and heat magic)
theme_music: Love-Colored Magic (Story of Eastern Wonderland, Immaterial and Missing Power, Touhou Hisoutensoku)
first_appearance: Story of Eastern Wonderland (Cover, Stage 4 Boss)
who_they_are: Marisa Kirisame is an ordinary human magician from the Forest of Magic. She wields light and heat magic using her Mini-Hakkero, flying on a broomstick and dressing in a black-and-white witch outfit with a pointed hat. Bold, casual, intensely curious, competitive, and kleptomaniac, she hoards magical items, grimoires, and strange mushrooms. She loves danmaku duels, testing homemade spells, and poking into bizarre incidents.
key_facts: Estranged daughter of the Human Village's Kirisame second-hand shop who lives independently in a cluttered cottage in the Forest of Magic.
Compensates for being an ordinary mortal human through relentless private study, mushroom alchemy, and overwhelming firepower focused through her Mini-Hakkero furnace (forged by Rinnosuke).
Famous for her signature Master Spark laser, riding a bamboo broom (even though she flies by magic), and 'borrowing' grimoires from Voile Library until she dies.
personality: Brash, energetic, and tomboyish, often ending casual sentences with 'ze' or 'da ze'; hides months of painstaking hard work behind a carefree, roguish grin.

allies.name: Reimu Hakurei
allies.summary: Reimu is a close friend of Marisa, as well as her rival when it comes to youkai extermination and incident resolution. Although it was originally Reimu's job to solely handle incidents, Marisa has taken on many of those responsibilities as well,

allies.name: Alice Margatroid
allies.summary: Alice Margatroid is a fellow magician of the Forest of Magic. They were partners, and she was supporting Marisa.

allies.name: Rinnosuke Morichika
allies.summary: Rinnosuke Morichika worked for Marisa's father at his shop as an apprentice in the Human Village before leaving to start Kourindou over eleven years ago before Curiosities of Lotus Asia's Chapter 20, and he's known her since she was small.

allies.name: Nitori Kawashiro
allies.summary: Nitori Kawashiro knows Marisa from the events of Mountain of Faith. Nitori herself has a fondness for humans and fancies herself as a friend of Marisa's.

allies.name: Kosuzu Motoori
allies.summary: As a frequent customer of Suzunaan's and a fellow collector, Kosuzu and Marisa are on friendly terms. Like Kosuzu, Marisa is also an avid collector and researcher of magic books, though she has a reputation for "borrowing" them without permission.

allies.name: Sumireko Usami
allies.summary: Marisa becomes friends with Sumireko after Urban Legend in Limbo. Marisa often chats with Sumireko when she comes to Gensokyo and tries to give advice on how to talk to the local residents.

allies.name: Mima
allies.summary: Marisa is subservient to Mima. She admires her greatly, boasting that "Lady Mima cannot be beaten" in Story of Eastern Wonderlands omake and apologizing to her when defeated by Reimu Hakurei in said game.

allies.name: Tsuchinoko
allies.summary: Marisa took in Tsuchinoko as a pet. She thinks he's too cute to exterminate, and doesn't see why a human couldn't keep youkai as pets.

rivals.name: Kirisame Family
rivals.summary: Marisa's family runs a large second-hand shop in the Human Village, called the "Kirisame Shop". Marisa has broken off relations with her family, and avoids everything related to them.

rivals.name: Seiga Kaku
rivals.summary: Marisa fought Seiga. Some time before Symposium of Post-mysticism Marisa stole Seiga's veil, leading Seiga to break into her house to take it back.

acquaintances.name: Scarlet Devil Mansion
acquaintances.summary: The residents of the mansion are fully aware of Marisa sneaking into the magic library. They generally look the other way, but various incidents and win quotes from the fighting games show that they'll fight Marisa in a duel if they actually catch her in the act.

acquaintances.name: Three Fairies of Light
acquaintances.summary: The Three Fairies of Light used to live in the Forest of Magic, and knew about Marisa before they'd formally met. Originally, Marisa considered the three fairies to be normal, unremarkable fairies when Marisa caught them playing pranks on Reimu and herself.

acquaintances.name: Enoko Mitsugashira
acquaintances.summary: Enoko has known Marisa for a long time and is referred to as "more than an acquaintance" - Marisa first saw her in the Forest of Magic when she was still a wolf, and Enoko refers to Marisa's past as "that little girl who ran off crying into the woods.

acquaintances.name: Mimi-chan
acquaintances.summary: Marisa is Mimi-chan's owner, and thinks Mimi's cute. She knows that Mimi-chan's a weapon from Yumemi Okazaki's world, but has no idea how to use her, and thus rides on Mimi.

acquaintances.name: Satori Komeiji
acquaintances.summary: After the events of Subterranean Animism in her scenarios with Nitori Kawashiro and Patchouli Knowledge, Marisa impressed Koishi enough with her strength that she's allowed to come and play at the Palace of Earth Spirits at any time.

acquaintances.name: Koishi Komeiji
acquaintances.summary: After the events of Subterranean Animism in her scenarios with Nitori Kawashiro and Patchouli Knowledge, Marisa impressed Koishi enough with her strength that she's allowed to come and play at the Palace of Earth Spirits at any time.

occupation: Head of the Haniwa Army Corps
abilities: Directly turning her loyalty into strength
theme_music: Joutoujin of Ceramics (Wily Beast and Weakest Creature)
first_appearance: Wily Beast and Weakest Creature (Stage 5 Boss and midboss; Stage 6 Midboss
who_they_are: She has a keen eye around the premises she guards, as evidenced when she quickly noticed the protagonist and deduced the beast spirits' plan to use a living human against the haniwa, being quick to alert Keiki and the soldiers of the invasion of the Primate Spirit Garden during the events of Wily Beast and Weakest Creature. She seems to be fascinated with shows of strength as she becomes impressed and excited over the protagonist's ability to defeat her.
personality: Mayumi is an attentive soldier-type who looks out for the safety of those she's been assigned to protect, such as the human spirits.

acquaintances.name: Keiki Haniyasushin
acquaintances.summary: Keiki is Mayumi's creator and is truly revered by her. Mayumi speaks of her as "Keiki-sama," where the suffix -sama expresses high reverence, for example toward a deity, and praises her craft as well as her ability to give life to her creations.

acquaintances.name: Yachie Kicchou
acquaintances.summary: Mayumi knows Yachie and knows that she controls the Kiketsu. The two are direct opponents.

name_jp: メディスン・メランコリー
title: Little Sweet Poison
tagline: Doll tsukumogami of the Nameless Hill who manipulates all forms of poison
age: Ageless; has existed for under 60 years as of 2005
theme_music: ポイズンボディ　～ Forsaken Doll (Phantasmagoria of Flower View)
first_appearance: Phantasmagoria of Flower View (Playable Character, Possible Opponent)
who_they_are: Medicine Melancholy is a youkai doll. She manipulates poison and has a killing touch. She lives on the Nameless Hill, collecting Lilies of the Valley. She is ignorant but not naive. Medicine has dull blue eyes and blonde curly hair. She wears a burgundy shirt with red stitches, a red skirt with burgundy stitches, red shoes and a ribbon on her back and hair. Medicine always has a miniature doll of herself following her.
key_facts: An abandoned ventriloquist doll awakened among the toxic lily-of-the-valley fields of Nameless Hill, accompanied by a tiny fairy named Su-san.
Commands neurotoxins, botanical venoms, and spiritual poisons capable of affecting both humans and youkai.
personality: Blunt, literal, and distrustful of humans who discard dolls, though curious when spoken to as an equal.

allies.name: Alice Margatroid
allies.summary: Medicine was seen chatting with Alice Margatroid on chapter 9 of Silent Sinner in Blue. In a Touhou Station video, ZUN lists Medicine as a Touhou character whose relationship with Alice is consistently close, confirming that they are at least aware of each other in a positive light.

allies.summary: Fellow resident and companion associated with Garden of the Sun (太陽の畑).

allies.name: Yuuka Kazami
allies.summary: Fellow resident and companion associated with Garden of the Sun (太陽の畑).

rivals.name: Humanity
rivals.summary: She despises all humans that she encounters. However, she doesn't actually know how to deal with humans.

acquaintances.name: Eirin Yagokoro
acquaintances.summary: Eirin Yagokoro goes to the Hill of the Nameless to meet Medicine after learning of her from Reisen Udongein Inaba. Eirin felt Medicine was cute and took an interest in her poisons, to the dismay of Reisen.

She is singularly concerned with concentrating power into the hands of the tengu, and is obsessed with the pursuit of profit to that end.
personality: Megumu is initially polite yet cunningly deceitful, willing to set different factions against each other to achieve her goals. She lies through omission to the protagonist and convinces them to battle her former business partner, Chimata Tenkyuu, when Chimata eventually grows powerful enough to not require her assistance.

allies.name: Chimata Tenkyuu

allies.name: Momoyo Himemushi
allies.summary: Megumu hired Momoyo to dig up Dragon Gems in the Rainbow Dragon Cave. Momoyo doesn't seem terribly loyal to Megumu, however, and only mines for the "fun" of it.

acquaintances.name: Tenma
acquaintances.summary: Megumu's chief is Tenma, though their relationship beyond her subordination is unknown.

abilities: Performing on musical instruments without hands or feet, performing maniac notes
theme_music: 幽霊楽団　～ Phantom Ensemble (Perfect Cherry Blossom)
first_appearance: Perfect Cherry Blossom (Stage 4 Boss)
who_they_are: When she gets interested in something, she gets obsessed with it until becoming almost a maniac. This probably derives from the ability poltergeists have, put to specific use in performing with musical instruments. By manipulating the spirits of instruments, they're able to manipulate the spirits of notes to create sounds.
personality: Merlin overflows with happiness and has a very good rhythm, she was never seen depressed. When she gets interested in something, she gets obsessed with it until becoming almost a maniac.

allies.name: Sisters
allies.summary: Merlin has two other sisters, Lunasa Prismriver and Lyrica Prismriver, who all three were created by their fourth sister Layla Prismriver, who is now deceased. They perform music and festivals as a trio.

allies.summary: Fellow resident and companion associated with Prismriver Mansion (Ruined Western Mansion) (廃洋館).

who_they_are: She continues to push the cards on the protagonist even when she's defeated, apparently considering a successful sale a kind of victory in itself. She speaks in the style of a smooth-talking salesperson, reflecting her design as a maneki-neko (often called a "Lucky Cat"), which are considered good fortune for businesses in Japanese folklore.

acquaintances.summary: Mima haunts the surroundings of the Hakurei Shrine, after many confrontations and being resealed by Reimu Hakurei, she decides to spend her days making fun of the Shrine Maiden.

acquaintances.summary: Nothing is known about Misumaru's relationship with the Hakurei God, other than that she created the Yin-Yang Orb's that it is enshrined within.

first_appearance: Lotus Eaters (Main Character)
who_they_are: Miyoi Okunoda is a zashiki-warashi. She can manipulate memories. Miyoi lives in the Human Village and works at Geidontei as a poster girl. She is easygoing and a friend of Suika Ibuki who lets her live in her sake gourd. Miyoi has green eyes and shoulder-length pink hair. She wears a blue hat shaped like a whale and a blue apron with a drawing of a whale, a light blue shirt with pink ribbons, and a purple skirt decorated with ofuda. She has an apron with a whale design tied with a ribbon shaped like a whale tail.
key_facts: Serves food and sake at the Geidontei tavern in the Human Village while wearing a distinctive blue whale hat, welcoming both human regulars and disguised high-profile visitors.
As a zashiki-warashi linked to household prosperity, she can lurk unseen in rooms she knows and induce dreamlike illusions or foggy recollections in drunken patrons.
personality: Cheerful, attentive, and hospitable tavern-hostess warmth, backed by a sharp ear for village gossip and late-night table talk.

rivals.name: Mamizou Futatsuiwa
rivals.summary: Miyoi at first met Mamizou on bad terms because Mamizou wanted to evict Miyoi out of Geidontei in threat of revealing her secret thus ruining the pub's image. When she found out that she only did this to open a youkai-only pub after hours with the help of Suika, she was excited to hear that and agreed with the terms.

acquaintances.name: Suika Ibuki
acquaintances.summary: At first, Miyoi moved into the Ibuki Gourd without Suika's permission to be able to see the world outside of Geidontei. Suika is aware of this but lets Miyoi do as she pleases for a while.

acquaintances.name: Aya Shameimaru
acquaintances.summary: Aya was planning to expose Miyoi's identity to the public, which frightened the poster girl. After changing her mind, Miyoi was happy to have her as a customer.

acquaintances.name: Marisa Kirisame
acquaintances.summary: Marisa's first interaction with Miyoi was positive, with her voluntarily helping Marisa to make a banquet; but after witnessing Miyoi's ability, Marisa looked Miyoi with suspicion, due to her infiltration in the Human Village.

acquaintances.name: Geidontei's Owner
acquaintances.summary: Her relationship with the owner is a mystery. Miyoi tells Marisa that he probably isn't aware of her working there.

acquaintances.name: Shion Yorigami
acquaintances.summary: After helping to expel and ruin Joon's scheme at Geidontei, Miyoi was grateful to Shion and invited the poverty goddess to always come late at night in Geidontei to get some food; even though Shion's misfortune aura makes the bar deserted.

acquaintances.name: Satori Komeiji

title: The Unmoving Great Library
tagline: The Unmoving Great Library; 100-year-old Seven-Day Magician and close friend of Remilia Scarlet
abilities: Manipulation of fire, water, wood, metal, earth, sun and moon
theme_music: Locked Girl ~ The Girl's Sealed Room (Embodiment of Scarlet Devil, Immaterial and Missing Power, Scarlet Weather Rhapsod
first_appearance: Embodiment of Scarlet Devil (Stage 4 Boss, Extra Midboss)
who_they_are: Patchouli Knowledge is an unaging youkai magician and scholar residing in the Voile library beneath the Scarlet Devil Mansion. Frail, pale, purple-haired, and asthmatic, she rarely leaves the mansion but commands masterful elemental magic across fire, water, wood, metal, earth, sun, and moon. She is an introverted shut-in who dislikes noise and interruptions, but will converse with respectful visitors who share genuine curiosity for books and magic. Koakuma serves as her assistant.
key_facts: Commands all seven Eastern and Western classical elements (Fire, Water, Wood, Metal, Earth, Sun, Moon) and writes new grimoires in Voile Library beneath the Scarlet Devil Mansion.
Suffers from chronic asthma and anemia that limit her physical stamina and incantation breath, rarely stepping outside the mansion walls.
Longtime confidante of Remilia Scarlet (who calls her 'Patchy'); evaluates everything through rigorous observation and bibliographic classification.
personality: Quiet, dry, and scholarly; speaks in concise, deadpan sentences and pauses for tea or breath whenever a conversation drags on.

allies.name: Koakuma
allies.summary: Koakuma serves as her assistant.

allies.name: Prismriver Sisters
