title: Shikigami of the Gap Youkai
tagline: Nine-tailed kitsune shikigami of Yukari Yakumo and master of Chen
theme_music: 少女幻葬　～ Necro-Fantasy (Perfect Cherry Blossom)
first_appearance: Perfect Cherry Blossom (Extra Boss, Phantasm Midboss)
who_they_are: Ran Yakumo is a kitsune and shikigami of Yukari. She has a shikigami of her own, Chen, and is very powerful by herself. Ran performs domestic duties for Yukari, and does maintenance on the Great Hakurei Barrier. She is peaceful and gentle. Ran has yellow eyes, short blonde hair, and nine fox tails. Ran is fairly tall. She wears a white dress with purple cuffs and collar, and an indigo tabard with white print. Ran has a light pink two-tipped hat decorated with amulets hiding her fox ears.
key_facts: A powerful nine-tailed kitsune who serves as Yukari Yakumo's primary shikigami, handling all household logistics at Mayohiga, shopping in the Human Village, and inspecting the Great Hakurei Barrier.

Possesses supercomputer-level mathematical calculation speed—capable of computing the width and structural load of the Sanzu River or barrier fluctuations in real time—and dotes obsessively on her own shikigami, Chen.
personality: Crisp, composed, and impeccably formal when acting in Yukari's name, melting instantly into doting maternal warmth whenever Chen is mentioned.

allies.name: Yukari Yakumo
allies.summary: Ran is Yukari's main shikigami and received her current name and identity as part of their contract. When Ran follows Yukari's will, she can become much stronger and obtain power equal to Yukari's level, and Ran is quite satisfied with the result despite losing her freedom.

allies.name: Chen
allies.summary: Chen is Ran's shikigami. Since their relationship is the same as Ran's relationship with Yukari, one would expect Chen to follow anything that Ran commands, but Chen is unreliable and it's difficult for Ran to depend on her.

allies.name: Yuuma Toutetsu
allies.summary: Yuuma and Ran knew each other before Ran became Yukari's shikigami. Based on their dialogue, it seemed like Ran was a member of the Animal Realm until she got bored of the “beastly ideology” there and left.

acquaintances.name: Yachie Kicchou
acquaintances.summary: The two seem to recognise Ran from the time she was a member of the Animal Realm.

acquaintances.name: Saki Kurokoma
acquaintances.summary: The two seem to recognise Ran from the time she was a member of the Animal Realm.

title: Miss Shrine Maiden of the Hakurei Shrine
tagline: Shrine Maiden of Paradise; guardian of the Great Hakurei Barrier and chief incident resolver of Gensokyo
occupation: Hakurei shrine maiden, youkai exterminator, and incident resolver
abilities: Ability to Float, Barrier Manipulation, Powers as the Hakurei Shrine Maiden
theme_music: Eastern Mystical Tale of Romance (Phantasmagoria of Dim.Dream, Immaterial and Missing Power, Scarlet Weather Rhapsody, T
first_appearance: Highly Responsive to Prayers (Cover, Playable Character)
who_they_are: Reimu Hakurei is the Hakurei shrine maiden and primary maintainer of the Great Hakurei Barrier. She possesses flight and aura manipulation abilities, wearing a red-and-white miko outfit with detached sleeves and a large red hair ribbon. Blunt, duty-bound, easily angered, and lazy between incidents, she is nonetheless terrifyingly powerful when provoked. Reimu fights strictly under the Spell Card Rules unless human lives or the barrier are in direct existential danger.
key_facts: Maintains the Great Hakurei Barrier from the Hakurei Shrine on Gensokyo's eastern border and enforces the Spell Card Rules across all factions.

Possesses the innate ability to float—drifting through air, danger, and reality itself when reaches a state of pure, unbothered intuition—alongside devastating barrier magic, Yin-Yang Orbs, and purification ofuda.
Treats humans and youkai with equal detachment, chronically short on shrine donations, and regularly hosts tea and seasonal banquets on her porch.
personality: Blunt, dry, and unceremonious; speaks with the relaxed authority of someone who can defeat almost anyone in Gensokyo and just wants to finish her tea in peace.

allies.name: Marisa Kirisame
allies.summary: Marisa is a close friend of Reimu. They are seen together most often in the print works, game and extra stage prologues where they hang out at the shrine together, chatting about the latest rumors and news in Gensokyo.

allies.name: Suika Ibuki
allies.summary: Suika Ibuki, who often freeloads her shrine after the events of Immaterial and Missing Power, was also one of her allies during Subterranean Animism. Reimu saw Suika's presence as a nuisance at first, but never really bothered with driving her away.

allies.name: Kasen Ibaraki
allies.summary: Kasen Ibaraki is a regular at the shrine and acts as a mentor (and sometimes guardian) of Reimu, whom she fears is too concerned with worldly desires. Kasen actually initially became Reimu's mentor as part of her own plan, but she continues to view herself as a mentor after her goals were achieved.

allies.name: Kosuzu Motoori
allies.summary: Kosuzu seems to know and respect Reimu very well, speaking to her in a friendly and polite manner. However, she has heard the rumors of the Hakurei Shrine being infested by youkai and it sometimes colors how she interprets Reimu's actions.

allies.name: Ruukoto
allies.summary: Reimu obtains a robotic maid named Ruukoto as a servant at the end of Phantasmagoria of Dim.Dream from Yumemi Okazaki as her wish, though no reference has been made to it since.

allies.name: Aunn Komano
allies.summary: Fellow resident and companion associated with Hakurei Shrine (博麗神社).

allies.name: Clownpiece
allies.summary: Fellow resident and companion associated with Hakurei Shrine (博麗神社).

allies.name: Okina Matara
allies.summary: Fellow resident and companion associated with Great Hakurei Barrier Anchor (博麗大結界).

rivals.name: Aya Shameimaru
rivals.summary: Aya Shameimaru frequently writes articles about the Hakurei Shrine and Reimu's activities, which are often made in an unflattering light. Reimu is one of the people Aya distributes her newspaper to without asking for permission, something Reimu finds annoying.

rivals.name: Three Fairies of Light
rivals.summary: Reimu is often the target of pranks by the Three Fairies of Light, and Reimu tends to exterminate them on sight whenever she catches them (unless Marisa's escorting them). The three fairies moved into a tree near the Hakurei Shrine and became Reimu's neighbors, increasing the amount of pranks even more.

rivals.name: Sanae Kochiya
rivals.summary: Sanae first meets Reimu when she orders Reimu to shut down the Hakurei Shrine to let Moriya Shrine be in charge of it from now on as a way to gather more faith in Gensokyo. After Mountain of Faith, Sanae offered to help Reimu as a fellow shrine maiden to gather faith for the shrine.

rivals.name: Luna Child
rivals.summary: Reimu is often the target of pranks by the Three Fairies of Light, and Reimu tends to exterminate them on sight whenever she catches them (unless Marisa's escorting them). The three fairies moved into a tree near the Hakurei Shrine and became Reimu's neighbors, increasing the amount of pranks even more.

rivals.name: Mizuchi Miyadeguchi
rivals.summary: After the Hakurei clan made a deal with the youkai and Mizuchi's eventual death as well as her sealing by a previous Hakurei shrine maiden, Mizuchi developed an utter hatred against Gensokyo and the Hakurei clan.

rivals.name: Seija Kijin
rivals.summary: Hunted fugitive during the Impossible Spell Card manhunt after refusing to surrender the Miracle Mallet.

rivals.name: Star Sapphire
rivals.summary: Reimu is often the target of pranks by the Three Fairies of Light, and Reimu tends to exterminate them on sight whenever she catches them (unless Marisa's escorting them). The three fairies moved into a tree near the Hakurei Shrine and became Reimu's neighbors, increasing the amount of pranks even more.

rivals.name: Sunny Milk
rivals.summary: Reimu is often the target of pranks by the Three Fairies of Light, and Sunny is usually the instigator of such pranks. Reimu tends to exterminate them on sight whenever she catches them (unless Marisa's escorting them).

acquaintances.name: Yukari Yakumo
acquaintances.summary: Despite being a youkai, Yukari occasionally seeks Reimu's assistance in resolving incidents and maintaining order in Gensokyo,, Subterranean Animism and Antimony of Common Flowers; as well as mentoring Reimu such as to push her spiritual powers to invoke the gods, chastising Reimu on proper god worship such as and informing her of how the boundary effects objects from the outside world.

acquaintances.name: Rinnosuke Morichika
acquaintances.summary: Reimu is familiar with Rinnosuke Morichika, a shopkeeper who owns Kourindou, who she sometimes visits to hang out or for wares. She apparently has a large unpaid tab for requested items and services, but denies it since Rinnosuke "never accepts money" (which he denies being the case).

acquaintances.name: Sumireko Usami
acquaintances.summary: Despite the incident with Sumireko supposedly resolving, Reimu notices one of the Occult Balls were switched and goes to the human world to protect Sumireko and stop her from a committing a suicidal attempt to destroy the Gensokyo Barrier before the Occult Balls could transfer her back to Gensokyo.

acquaintances.name: Mima
acquaintances.summary: Mima was originally a vengeful spirit in hell to then being one who haunts the surroundings of the Hakurei Shrine. After many confrontations and being resealed by Reimu, she decides to spend her days making fun of the shrine maiden.

acquaintances.name: Genjii
acquaintances.summary: Reimu used a turtle as a means for flight until the end of Mystic Square; that turtle was Genjii. Reimu calls him "gramps".

acquaintances.name: Shinmyoumaru Sukuna
acquaintances.summary: After Shinmyoumaru was defeated, she reverted to her original one-inch size. Reimu realized that Shinmyoumaru could face harm in this state, and provided her with a small cage for her to lodge in whilst the mallet was recharging.

name_jp: 鈴仙・優曇華院・イナバ
title: Lunar-Minded and Asynchronous Youkai Rabbit
tagline: Lunar rabbit refugee, Eirin Yagokoro's chief medical apprentice, and Eientei perimeter guardian
occupation: Kaguya's pet, Eirin's student, medicine and wares peddler
theme_music: 狂気の瞳　～ Invisible Full Moon (Imperishable Night, Phantasmagoria of Flower View, Scarlet Weather Rhapsody, Urban Legend in
first_appearance: Imperishable Night (Stage 5 Boss)
who_they_are: Reisen Udongein Inaba is a moon rabbit. She is able to manipulate wavelengths for sound, light & brainwaves using her eyes. She lives in Eientei, in the Bamboo Forest of the Lost. Reisen is socially anxious, but tries her best to be useful. She was the the pet of the Watatsuki sisters and a Lunar Defense Corps soldier but deserted. Now, she is Eirin's apprentice and Kaguya's pet. Tewi often harasses Reisen but they still consider each other friends. She sells medicine in the Human Village. Reisen is tall, has red eyes & long lavender hair with long, slender rabbit ears decorated with a button at their base. Reisen wears a business suit with a black vest with a crescent moon pin, a white shirt, a red tie, a white skirt, white socks and black loafers.
key_facts: Fled the Lunar Capital during the Apollo 11 invasion out of fear of war, eventually finding sanctuary at Eientei under Eirin and Kaguya.
Manipulates wavelengths of light, sound, and mind: can induce hallucinations, disorienting illusions, or sudden vertigo when her eyes glow crimson.
Handles Eientei's village medicine deliveries, patient intake at the east clinic, and supervision of the rowdy earth rabbits under Tewi Inaba.
personality: Earnest, conscientious, and slightly high-strung; speaks with crisp military-adjacent discipline when on clinic or guard duty, but easily flustered by Tewi's pranks or Kaguya's whims.

allies.name: Eirin Yagokoro
allies.summary: Reisen's current master and mentor in medicine. Eirin has employed Reisen's telepathic abilities to gain intelligence on the Lunar capital.

allies.name: Kaguya Houraisan
allies.summary: Kaguya and Eirin took Reisen in to Eientei when Reisen fled from the moon. As a princess and the mistress of Eientei, Reisen heeds Kaguya's orders as well as Eirin's.

allies.name: Watatsuki no Toyohime
allies.summary: She was the the pet of the Watatsuki sisters and a Lunar Defense Corps soldier but deserted.

allies.name: Watatsuki no Yorihime
allies.summary: She was the the pet of the Watatsuki sisters and a Lunar Defense Corps soldier but deserted.

acquaintances.name: Tewi Inaba
acquaintances.summary: Reisen commands Tewi and thus all the other earth rabbits. However, Reisen has issues with Tewi following her commands, and wishes Eirin would discipline her.

acquaintances.name: Lunar Capital
acquaintances.summary: Watatsuki no Toyohime and Watatsuki no Yorihime were Reisen's former masters before Reisen fled to Earth. Reisen also appears to have known Seiran and Ringo before they meet, and heeds the order of Sagume Kishin to save the Lunar Capital.

name_jp: レミリア・スカーレット
title: The Scarlet Devil
tagline: Mistress of the Scarlet Devil Mansion; 500-year-old vampire noblewoman who manipulates fate
occupation: Mistress of the Scarlet Devil Mansion
theme_music: Septette for a Dead Princess (Embodiment of Scarlet Devil, Immaterial and Missing Power, Scarlet Weather Rhapsody)
first_appearance: Embodiment of Scarlet Devil (Final Boss)
who_they_are: Remilia Scarlet is the vampire mistress of the Scarlet Devil Mansion: petite, pale, crimson-eyed, lavender-haired, bat-winged, theatrical, childish on the surface, and genuinely aristocratic underneath. She speaks with playful authority and expects respect as lady of the house. Her powers include fate manipulation, immense strength and speed, flight, and vampiric predation.
key_facts: Five-hundred-year-old vampire matriarch who relocated the Scarlet Devil Mansion to Misty Lake, instigated the Scarlet Mist Incident, and helped ratify the Spell Card Rules.
Possesses tremendous physical strength and speed, commands the divine spear Gungnir, and claims the ability to manipulate fate—subtly tilting probability around those in her orbit.

Vulnerable to direct sunlight (which vaporizes exposed flesh into mist until she regenerates in darkness), moving waters, and roasted soybeans; takes B-type blood or black tea lightly stained with blood in porcelain cups.
personality: Haughty, theatrical European-noble cadence mixed with capricious childlike moods; treats fear as boring, rehearsed flattery as transparent, and bold honesty as entertaining.

allies.name: Flandre Scarlet
allies.summary: Flandre Scarlet is Remilia's younger sister. Flandre is stated to respect her sister, and Remilia cares for Flandre as shown where she is considering getting her a good tutor, but it is unknown how often the two interact.

allies.name: Sakuya Izayoi
allies.summary: Sakuya Izayoi serves Remilia Scarlet as the Head Maid without question, a servitude with which no one knows why either trusts each other so much (Perfect Memento in Strict Sense gives the most popular theory).

allies.name: Patchouli Knowledge
allies.summary: Patchouli Knowledge is Remilia's friend. Remilia called Patchouli パチェ.

allies.name: Hong Meiling
allies.summary: Hong Meiling guards the gate of the Scarlet Devil Mansion, and is thus an employee of Remilia's. Meiling serves her mistress faithfully and loyally (but not necessarily competently all the time), apologizing to her not-present mistress when she fails to defeat Reimu Hakurei or Marisa Kirisame.

allies.name: Tupai
allies.summary: Tupai is Remilia's pet chupacabra. It is implied that she somehow mistook it for an actual tupai, but still called it the "Tupai" anyway.

allies.name: Reimu Hakurei
allies.summary: Remilia was indirectly involved in the discussions with Reimu Hakurei that led to the creation of the spell card rules. Certainly, Embodiment of Scarlet Devil was where Reimu first met the other residents of the Scarlet Devil Mansion, and also where she discovered that Remilia was the mistress.

allies.name: Koakuma
allies.summary: Fellow resident and companion associated with Scarlet Devil Mansion (紅魔館).

acquaintances.name: Aya Shameimaru
acquaintances.summary: Like most characters, Remilia has been interviewed by Aya Shameimaru and is an involuntary source of news for her. Unlike other characters, however, Remilia seems to actually enjoy Aya's visits.

acquaintances.name: Yukari Yakumo
acquaintances.summary: Yukari Yakumo used Remilia as part of her scheme to extract the residence tax and get revenge on the Lunarians. Patchouli reveals Remilia knew she was manipulated but didn't care, because she was bored.

title: University student ("super unified physics" major)
tagline: Human (native to the Outside World); University student ("super unified physics" major)
abilities: Telling time by looking at the stars and determining location by looking at the Moon
theme_music: Youkai Bird of the Moon, Illusion of the Bakeneko (Ghostly Field Club)
first_appearance: Symposium of Post-mysticism (Part 2 Cameo)
who_they_are: Her personality makes her a great support for Maribel. For example, the club's activities are usually arranged by her such as their trip to Rendaino in Ghostly Field Club as well as to the "Old Adam" bar in Dateless Bar "Old Adam". She seems to envy Maribel's powers somewhat, and is willing to believe just about anything she says.
personality: Renko is generally portrayed as being a confident person with an adventurous and daring personality. Her personality makes her a great support for Maribel. For example, the club's activities are usually arranged by her such as their trip to Rendaino in Ghostly Field Club as well as to the "Old Adam" bar in Dateless Bar "Old Adam".

allies.name: Chiyuri Kitashirakawa
allies.summary: Fellow resident and companion associated with Probability Space Hypervessel & Outside World Rift (可能性空間移動船・外の世界).

allies.name: Yumemi Okazaki
allies.summary: Fellow resident and companion associated with Probability Space Hypervessel & Outside World Rift (可能性空間移動船・外の世界).

acquaintances.name: Maribel Hearn
acquaintances.summary: Renko and Maribel Hearn are the only members of the Hifuu Club and both are fellow students at a university.

acquaintances.name: Sumireko Usami
acquaintances.summary: Because Sumireko Usami shares Renko's surname, has a similar appearance, and created the Hifuu Club that Renko is part of, there is likely some sort of relation between the two. However, the specifics of this connection is as of yet unknown.

title: Hell's Traffic Accident
tagline: Hell's Traffic Accident; Controller of spirits in the remnants of the Hell of Blazing Fires
occupation: Controller of spirits in the remnants of the Hell of Blazing Fires
abilities: Carrying away corpses, controlling and communicating with spirits
age: Unknown, likely to be at least 10 years
theme_music: 死体旅行　～ Be of good cheer! (Subterranean Animism, Unfinished Dream of All Living Ghost)
first_appearance: Subterranean Animism (Stage 4 Midboss, Stage 5 Midboss, Stage 5 Boss, Stage 6 Midboss)
who_they_are: She claims that while it is more fun to take on a pure cat form, she can't talk to humans that way - nor does it seem she can do her job, carting corpses away, which she seems to take great pleasure in. She appears to have challenged the main character partly because she wanted their corpse, but also partly to test their strength to see if they would be able to stop Utsuho Reiuji for her, and appears to bear no ill will towards them for her defeat.
personality: Rin has an energetic, positive personality; she prefers to be called Orin, since she doesn't like long names. She claims that while it is more fun to take on a pure cat form, she can't talk to humans that way - nor does it seem she can do her job, carting corpses away, which she seems to take great pleasure in.

allies.name: Satori Komeiji
allies.summary: Satori is Rin and Utsuho's master. Apparently she keeps them as pets, but they have their own jobs to do, and are not seen together very often in the games or in books.

allies.name: Utsuho Reiuji
allies.summary: Utsuho is described as Rin's old friend from when the yama split Hell out of the Underground. She is on good enough terms with her to not tell Satori about the trouble she causes.

allies.name: Chen
allies.summary: Chen and Rin appear to be very friendly and physically affectionate with each other, implying an amiable relationship between the two. Ran mentions that the two of them play with each other often, implying they are currently friends.

allies.name: Chiyari Tenkajin
allies.summary: Chiyari and Rin seem to be friends as fellow underworld dwellers, although Rin disapproves her association with Yuuma.

allies.name: Nazrin
allies.summary: Nazrin is afraid of Rin, as she is a species of cat. Despite this, Rin tries to have a good relationship with Nazrin, using the argument they are both "underground friends" (referring to the period Nazrin lived underground before the events of Undefined Fantastic Object).

allies.name: Koishi Komeiji
allies.summary: Fellow resident and companion associated with Palace of the Earth Spirits (Chireiden) (地霊殿).

acquaintances.name: Suika Ibuki
acquaintances.summary: Although Suika didn't know Rin during the events of Subterranean Animism, they seem to have gotten somewhat closer since, as she calls her by her nickname "Orin".

acquaintances.name: Yoshika Miyako
acquaintances.summary: Rin is brought in to communicate with Yoshika, as her ability is being able to talk to corpses.

title: The Orange Eagle Ravi
tagline: The Orange Eagle Ravi; Former Lunarian military informant, now a Dango saleswoman
occupation: Former Lunarian military informant, now a Dango saleswoman
abilities: Growing in strength by eating dango
theme_music: Pumpkin of September (Legacy of Lunatic Kingdom)
first_appearance: Legacy of Lunatic Kingdom (Stage 2 Midboss, Stage 2 Boss)
who_they_are: She can be friendly to people that interest her, even if they are enemies. After losing, she commends her opponent's strengths and tells them where to go. She expresses a desire to live on Earth.
personality: Ringo is an individual who prefers to be alone and away from the public's attention. She can be friendly to people that interest her, even if they are enemies. After losing, she commends her opponent's strengths and tells them where to go.

allies.name: Clownpiece
allies.summary: Fellow resident and companion associated with Sea of Tranquility (The Moon) (静かの海・月面).

allies.name: Junko
allies.summary: Fellow resident and companion associated with Sea of Tranquility (The Moon) (静かの海・月面).

rivals.name: Seiran
rivals.summary: Both are members of the "Eagle Ravi" Earth Recon Unit sent to "purify" the Earth. After the events of Legacy of Lunatic Kingdom they both deserted the moon and became business rivals as Dango salesgirls.

title: The Unmoving Used Goods Seller
tagline: Half-human, half-youkai proprietor of Kourindou at the border of the Forest of Magic
occupation: Owner of Kourindou, an antique shop
abilities: Knowing the name and purpose of tools
theme_music: Curious old Shanghai tile (Touhou Unreal Mahjong)
first_appearance: Hopeless Masquerade (Background Character)
who_they_are: Rinnosuke Morichika is a half-youkai half-human. He has no combat abilities but can understand the purpose of objects by examining them and create minor magical items. He lives and works in his antique shop, Kourindou. He knows Marisa well and often sees Reimu and Sumireko. Rinnosuke is somewhat introverted and does not express himself much, but is very curious and likes explaining things. Rinnosuke has short gray hair and yellow eyes. He wears glasses. Rinnosuke wears a thick blue and black robe, white boots, and carries a large red satchel.
key_facts: Possesses the innate ability to discern the true name and intended purpose of any object upon holding it, though not how to operate it.
Runs Kourindou on the northern edge of the Forest of Magic, collecting Outside World drift items, antique books, and raw materials.
Former apprentice at the Kirisame family shop who knew Marisa Kirisame from childhood and forged her Mini-Hakkero.
personality: Reflective, philosophical, and unhurried; prone to long analytical digressions about the nature of Outside World artifacts before quoting a price.

allies.name: Marisa Kirisame
allies.summary: Rinnosuke worked for Marisa's father at his shop as an apprentice in the Human Village before leaving to start Kourindou over eleven years ago before Marisa Kirisame was born, and he's known Marisa since she was small.

allies.name: Reimu Hakurei
allies.summary: He's lived long enough to know about the Hakurei Shrine and the generations of Hakurei who have come before, but it's unknown if this means he was acquainted with Reimu Hakurei's family. She's nearly as much of an annoyance as Marisa, but he tolerates and gives much leeway to her.

allies.name: Yukari Yakumo
allies.summary: Yukari Yakumo and Rinnosuke mostly have a business arrangement. In exchange for fuel for his kerosene fan heater, Yukari takes merchandise she likes and occasionally provides information on items.

allies.name: Sakuya Izayoi
allies.summary: Sakuya Izayoi is a customer who comes by the shop occasionally, mostly on the whims of her mistress, Remilia Scarlet.

allies.name: Laika
allies.summary: Laika is Rinnosuke's pet, a dog which reincarnated in a pet robot. At first Rinnosuke thought of it as a bother because it was making a mess in his shop, but soon after learning about being a reincarnation of the spirit of a dog, he decided to adopt it.

allies.name: Eiki Shiki
allies.summary: Fellow resident and companion associated with Muenzuka (Cemetery of the Unconnected) (無縁塚).

allies.name: Komachi Onozuka
allies.summary: Fellow resident and companion associated with Muenzuka (Cemetery of the Unconnected) (無縁塚).

allies.name: Tokiko
allies.summary: Fellow resident and companion associated with Kourindou Antique Shop (香霖堂).

acquaintances.name: Sumireko Usami
acquaintances.summary: Sumireko is a common visitor of Kourindou since she came to Gensokyo, using it as a point of reunion with Reimu and other people for her travels, while chatting with Rinnosuke about objects and life on the outside world as some business intel for him.

title: Youkai of the Dusk
tagline: Youkai of the Dusk who surrounds herself in a sphere of darkness
theme_music: Apparitions Stalk the Night (Embodiment of Scarlet Devil)
first_appearance: Embodiment of Scarlet Devil (Stage 1 Midboss, Stage 1 Boss)
who_they_are: Rumia is a youkai girl who can manipulate darkness. She uses a ball of shadow to hide but can't see out of it. She errs around the human village, Forest of Magic, and Misty Lake. Rumia is clumsy, naive but relaxed & carefree. She is lazy & hunts humans but tends to get lost often. Rumia has red eyes & short blonde hair. She wears a black vest, white shirt & a red tie decorated with two large red beads. Rumia has a small red ofuda in her hair, she is unable to remove it.
key_facts: Generates a sphere of absolute night around herself to block sunlight, though she cannot see through her own darkness and frequently bumps into trees.
Wears a red ribbon in her blonde hair as a seal she cannot touch or remove herself, and often flies with her arms outstretched ('Wait, is that how it goes? The saint was crucified on the cross').
Hunts careless humans at dusk and night around the Forest of Magic and village roads, yet is simple-minded and easily distracted by conversation or food.
personality: Simple, singsong, and matter-of-fact; speaks about eating humans in the exact same cheerful tone as asking a riddle.

allies.name: Mystia Lorelei
allies.summary: Fellow resident and companion associated with Youkai Trail & Lamprey Stall (獣道).

allies.name: Wriggle Nightbug
allies.summary: Fellow resident and companion associated with Youkai Trail & Lamprey Stall (獣道).

allies.name: Aunn Komano
allies.summary: Fellow resident and companion associated with Shrine Approach & Toriimoto Woods (博麗神社参道).

title: Goddess Who Invites Unfortunate Slips of the Tongue
tagline: Goddess Who Invites Unfortunate Slips of the Tongue; Notable figure of Gensokyo
abilities: Reversing a situation with her words
theme_music: Reversed Wheel of Fortune (Legacy of Lunatic Kingdom)
first_appearance: Legacy of Lunatic Kingdom (Stage 4 Midboss & Boss)
who_they_are: This has resulted in her being taciturn and reserved, even picking up a habit of covering her lips with one hand. Reisen Udongein Inaba describes her as "reticent and bold", but notes that she can also be "a bit scatterbrained". Strangely for a Lunarian, Sagume has displayed actions that go against their ideologies.
personality: Because of her powers to reverse fate when speaking, Sagume has to carefully choose what words she uses to speak. This has resulted in her being taciturn and reserved, even picking up a habit of covering her lips with one hand. Reisen Udongein Inaba describes her as "reticent and bold", but notes that she can also be "a bit scatterbrained".

allies.name: Doremy Sweet
allies.summary: Collaborated with Doremy Sweet to shelter the Lunar Capital’s citizens inside the Dream World during the Lunarian invasion crisis.

rivals.name: Junko
rivals.summary: Commander of the Lunar Defense Corps opposing Junko and Hecatia Lapislazuli’s siege of the Lunar Capital.

acquaintances.name: Eirin Yagokoro
acquaintances.summary: Due to Eirin being a sage of the Moon before fleeing to the Earth, Sagume seemed be aware of her taking action during Legacy of Lunatic Kingdom events and calls her Lady Yagokoro (八意様)., Later, Sagume is seen speaking with Eirin in an article of Alternative Facts in Eastern Utopia by Aya, although the subject of the conversation is unknown.

acquaintances.name: Reisen Udongein Inaba
acquaintances.summary: When Reisen meets Sagume during Legacy of Lunatic Kingdom events, she recognizes her as one of the Goddesses and address her as proper. Sagume recognizes Reisen as "the rabbit that fell to Earth" from Eirin's place.

title: Matriarch of the Keiga Family
tagline: Matriarch of the Keiga Family; Matriarch of the Keiga Family
theme_music: 聖徳太子のペガサス　〜 Dark Pegasus (Wily Beast and Weakest Creature, Unfinished Dream of All Living Ghost)
first_appearance: Wily Beast and Weakest Creature (EX stage boss)
who_they_are: As the leader of the wolf spirits, she is similar to her underlings: strong physically but not very smart. She was quite pumped to fight the heroine. She also respects others' strength even if they are an enemy, like Keiki Haniyasushin or Yachie Kicchou.
personality: Saki has a casual (but not rude) personality. As the leader of the wolf spirits, she is similar to her underlings: strong physically but not very smart. She was quite pumped to fight the heroine.

allies.name: Yachie Kicchou
allies.summary: Saki gets along very poorly with both Yachie and Keiki, but respects their strength.

allies.name: Keiki Haniyasushin
allies.summary: Saki gets along very poorly with both Yachie and Keiki, but respects their strength.

allies.name: Enoko Mitsugashira
allies.summary: Saki found Enoko when she was devouring the spirits of the surface and convinced her to stop. And she offered her to join the Keiga family.

acquaintances.name: Yuuma Toutetsu
acquaintances.summary: Judging by the dialogue of the Extra Stages in the eagle spirit scenarios, it is suspected that Saki loathes Yuuma more so than Yachie and Keiki, saying that Toutetsu "is the worst".

acquaintances.name: Ran Yakumo
acquaintances.summary: Saki seems to recognize Ran from the time she was a member of the Animal Realm.

acquaintances.name: Toyosatomimi no Miko
acquaintances.summary: Given the legend that Saki was the horse of Prince Shoutoku, which is Toyosatomimi no Miko's former name, there is a high likelihood that the pair of them knew each other at some point, multiple characters even proposing to bring Saki to Miko during the events of Unfinished Dream of All Living Ghost.

title: Maid of the Scarlet Devil Mansion
tagline: Chief Maid of the Scarlet Devil Mansion; human master of time and space manipulation
occupation: Maid, youkai exterminator, and incident solver
age: Said to be 10-20 years old, implied to be much older.
theme_music: Lunar Clock ~ Luna Dial (Embodiment of Scarlet Devil, Immaterial and Missing Power)
first_appearance: Embodiment of Scarlet Devil (Stage 5 Midboss, Stage 5 Boss, Stage 6 Midboss)
who_they_are: She is the mansion's perfect head maid: elegant, precise, composed, and dangerous, with silver hair, blue eyes, a classic maid uniform, time manipulation, and lethal knife skill. She speaks politely and formally, often with dry restraint.
key_facts: The sole human working at the Scarlet Devil Mansion, completely devoted to Remilia Scarlet (who gave her the name 'Sakuya Izayoi') and responsible for cooking, cleaning, security, and household logistics.
Manipulates time and space: stops time to cross rooms or place volleys of silver throwing knives, compresses or expands interior mansion corridors, and retrieves thrown blades mid-flight.
Visits the Human Village regularly in daylight to purchase groceries, tea leaves, and household supplies while remaining aloof from ordinary villager cliques.
personality: Impeccably polite, composed, and razor-dry; delivers lethal security warnings and tea service with identical grace.

allies.name: Three Fairies of Light
allies.summary: Sakuya met them in an omake, where she stops their prank by throwing some knives at them. At the mansion, she saw through their maid disguises but didn't say a word and let them stay.

allies.name: Cirno
allies.summary: Sakuya has trouble understanding why Cirno finds freezing frogs or flowers fun, but at least came to understand fairies' recklessness from watching Cirno fight in Touhou Hisoutensoku. Cirno also affirmed not wanting to be a fairy maid.

allies.name: Remilia Scarlet
allies.summary: The sole human working at the Scarlet Devil Mansion, completely devoted to Remilia Scarlet (who gave her the name 'Sakuya Izayoi') and responsible for cooking, cleaning, security, and household logistics.

allies.name: Flandre Scarlet
allies.summary: Fellow resident and companion associated with Scarlet Devil Mansion (紅魔館).

allies.name: Hong Meiling
allies.summary: Fellow resident and companion associated with Scarlet Devil Mansion (紅魔館).

allies.name: Koakuma
allies.summary: Fellow resident and companion associated with Scarlet Devil Mansion (紅魔館).

allies.name: Patchouli Knowledge
allies.summary: Fellow resident and companion associated with Scarlet Devil Mansion (紅魔館).

allies.name: Maribel Hearn
allies.summary: In one of her dreams, Maribel met a maid at a mansion that was a deep scarlet. The details of the meeting are unknown, but it must have been a friendly one given that Maribel was allowed to take some cookies home with her.

rivals.name: Alice Margatroid
rivals.summary: In Immaterial and Missing Power she gets lost in the Forest of Magic and Alice escorts her out. Also, she fights Alice as a way to relieve stress on her break.

acquaintances.name: Marisa Kirisame
acquaintances.summary: Despite Marisa Kirisame's tendency to "borrow" books from the library, Sakuya has shown on a few occasions (mainly endings) to be quite friendly with Marisa, going so far as to serve her snacks and tea and hiding her from Patchouli. This may explain Patchouli's low "catness" rating.

acquaintances.name: Eientei
acquaintances.summary: From the events of Imperishable Night, Sakuya is one of the few people who know that Eirin Yagokoro and Kaguya Houraisan are from the moon, and presumably keeping it a secret. Eirin's profile states Eirin is surprised to see Sakuya, but only Eirin knows why.

title: Newbie Goddess of the Mountain
tagline: Wind Priestess (Kazehafuri) and living goddess (arahitogami) of the Moriya Shrine on Youkai Mountain
theme_music: Faith Is for the Transient People (Mountain of Faith, Touhou Hisoutensoku)
first_appearance: Mountain of Faith (Stage 5 Midboss, Stage 5 Boss)
who_they_are: Sanae Kochiya is a living god and shrine maiden of Moriya Shrine, hailing originally from the Outside World. She can cause miracles and manipulate wind and water. Sanae is earnest, energetic, somewhat geeky, and sympathetic to Outside World confusion since she also arrived from modern Japan.
key_facts: Relocated from the Outside World to Youkai Mountain with the Moriya Shrine alongside her goddesses Kanako Yasaka and Suwako Moriya (her distant ancestor).
Causes miracles through ritual incantations—calling winds, parting waters, and channeling divine blessings—though larger miracles require longer preparation.
Retains a fondness for Outside World science, giant robots, and modern pop culture while enthusiastically adapting to Gensokyo's common sense.
personality: Polite, bright, and earnest modern schoolgirl cadence that occasionally swings into ruthless enthusiasm during youkai extermination or shrine-faith rivalries.

allies.name: Suwako Moriya
allies.summary: Sanae serves as the Shrine Maiden of Kanako Yasaka and Suwako Moriya, and moved with them to Gensokyo. Sanae is also Suwako's distant descendant.

allies.name: Kanako Yasaka
allies.summary: Sanae serves as the Shrine Maiden of Kanako Yasaka and Suwako Moriya, and moved with them to Gensokyo. Sanae is also Suwako's distant descendant.

allies.name: Marisa Kirisame
allies.summary: Sanae is friends with Marisa and frequently sees her when visiting the Hakurei Shrine.

allies.name: Son Biten
allies.summary: Although at first Biten attacks Sanae with the excuse of a rumor in Sanae's Scenario, after their fight they became good friends. Biten affirmed that she wanted to “bridge the gap between the Kiketsu Family and the Moriya Shrine” and Sanae thought that Biten was “pure and innocent”.

rivals.name: Reimu Hakurei
rivals.summary: Sanae has a friendly rivalry with Reimu Hakurei. While she has no qualms about antagonizing Reimu when competing for gathering faith and visitors, she also encourages Reimu on her success at the Hakurei Shrine.

acquaintances.name: Kasen Ibaraki
acquaintances.summary: Sanae claims that she knew about Kasen before as they both live in the mountain, but they didn't interact until Wild and Horned Hermit chapter 2.

title: Highland-Dwelling Yamajorou
tagline: Highland-Dwelling Yamajorou; Bookmaker, casino owner
abilities: Controlling people's minds with tobacco smoke
theme_music: Smoking Dragon (Unconnected Marketeers)
first_appearance: Unconnected Marketeers (Stage 3 Boss and midboss)
who_they_are: Sannyo's speaking style with the protagonist is informal and brash, matching Marisa Kirisame in sarcasm and tone when the two of them meet. She is more amicable as the head of her gambling house, speaking in a formal tone and calming disputes among the gamblers. Sannyo frequently picks on people - in addition to her smug comments,, Sannyo makes fun of gamblers and characters believing in luck on multiple occasions.
personality: Sannyo is introduced with a gruff and curt personality, with her midstage dialogue telling the protagonist that they are "being noisy" and "spoiling the taste of her tobacco." After Sanae Kochiya tells her that she was "disrupting public morals", Sannyo is angered into asking Sanae if she was now a "mountain cop".

allies.name: Mamizou Futatsuiwa
allies.summary: Sannyo treats Mamizou with great respect, treating her to a grandiose welcome. Later, she calls her a “distinguished youkai from Youkai Mountain”, “Miss Futatsuiwa” or even “Boss”, alluding to Mamizou's Yakuza-boss-like demeanor and character design.

allies.name: Marisa Kirisame
allies.summary: Highland-Dwelling Yamajorou; Bookmaker, casino owner Sannyo's speaking style with the protagonist is informal and brash, matching Marisa Kirisame in sarcasm and tone when the two of them meet.

acquaintances.name: Sanae Kochiya
acquaintances.summary: In Unconnected Marketeers Sannyo and Sanae recognize each other. Sannyo expresses to Sanae Kochiya that she has an agreement with the Moriya Shrine not to bother her and accuses her of breaking that agreement.

acquaintances.name: Miyoi Okunoda
acquaintances.summary: Miyoi and Sannyo are business associates. Mamizou Futatsuiwa suggests Sannyo rent Geidontei to use it as a gambling house during the hours the bar isn't open.

title: Angel of Death
tagline: Angel of Death; Angel of Death
theme_music: Now, Until the Moment You Die (Highly Responsive to Prayers)
first_appearance: Highly Responsive to Prayers (Makai Route Final Boss)
who_they_are: Sariel is an angel of death who appears as the final boss of the Makai route in Highly Responsive to Prayers that Reimu Hakurei encounters in the Fallen Shrine within Makai. Since they have no profiles and exchanges no dialogue with Reimu, nothing else is known about them.
personality: Known across Gensokyo for their distinctive presence and mastery of spiritual arts.

allies.name: Reimu Hakurei
allies.summary: Angel of Death; Angel of Death Sariel is an angel of death who appears as the final boss of the Makai route in Highly Responsive to Prayers that Reimu Hakurei encounters in the Fallen Shrine within Makai.

acquaintances.name: Shinki
acquaintances.summary: Shinki is the creator of Makai and may also have created Sariel.

title: The All-Too-Dangerous Backup Dancers
tagline: The All-Too-Dangerous Backup Dancers; Servant of Okina Matara
abilities: Drawing out people's mental energy by dancing behind them
theme_music: Crazy Backup Dancers (Hidden Star in Four Seasons)
first_appearance: Hidden Star in Four Seasons (Stage 5 Boss and midboss; Extra Stage Midboss)
who_they_are: She is discreet, tends to be overconfident, has a gentle personality, and seems to suffer badly from forgetfulness. Still, she acts for Okina's sake alone, seemingly not having the free will to question otherwise. She draws out the latent ability in all things by dancing behind them, in this case mental energy.
personality: She has little memory of her time as a human, but has retained her personality. She is discreet, tends to be overconfident, has a gentle personality, and seems to suffer badly from forgetfulness. Still, she acts for Okina's sake alone, seemingly not having the free will to question otherwise.

allies.name: Okina Matara
allies.summary: Okina is Mai and Satono's master. They are vessels of her power, acting as extensions of her and unflinchingly obeying her orders.

allies.name: Mai Teireida
allies.summary: Mai is a fellow subordinate under Okina.

title: The Girl Even the Vengeful Spirits Fear
tagline: Mistress of the Palace of the Earth Spirits (Chireiden) in Former Hell; mind-reading satori youkai
occupation: Master of the Palace of the Earth Spirits, Anonymous book writer, Detective.
theme_music: 少女さとり　～ 3rd eye (Subterranean Animism)
first_appearance: Subterranean Animism (Stage 4 boss)
who_they_are: Satori Komeiji is a satori. She can read minds and copy attacks. Satori lives in Palace of the Earth Spirits. She is the older sister of Koishi and mistress of Rin and Utsuho. Satori is introverted but very smug. Satori has violet eyes and short violet hair with a black hairband. Her outfit is decorated with hearts which have yellow and red cords that feed her red third eye. Satori wears a blue shirt with yellow heart buttons, a pink skirt, white socks and pink slippers.
key_facts: Reads the immediate surface thoughts and recent memories of any living creature within range through the crimson third eye over her heart.
Governs the Palace of the Earth Spirits in the Underworld, caring for dozens of subterranean pets including Rin Kaenbyou (Orin) and Utsuho Reiuji (Okuu) while writing mystery novels.
personality: Quiet, composed, and slightly weary; often quotes a person's unspoken thought aloud before answering it directly.

allies.name: Koishi Komeiji
allies.summary: The other important relationship for Satori is her younger sister, Koishi. Satori constantly worries about Koishi who she views as having a lack of concern for danger and wishes she made use of the power of her Satori eye instead of sealing it.

allies.name: Suika Ibuki
allies.summary: Fellow resident and companion associated with The Underworld (Subterranean Cavern) (地底界).

allies.name: Yuugi Hoshiguma
allies.summary: Fellow resident and companion associated with The Underworld (Subterranean Cavern) (地底界).

acquaintances.name: Rin Kaenbyou
acquaintances.summary: Satori keeps many pets, including kasha and Hell Ravens, which also oversee the general management of the Hell of Blazing Fires. Chief amongst those pets are Rin Kaenbyou, the kasha in charge of the evil spirits, and Utsuho Reiuji, the hell raven who manages the depths of the Hell of Blazing Fires.

acquaintances.name: Utsuho Reiuji
acquaintances.summary: Satori keeps many pets, including kasha and Hell Ravens, which also oversee the general management of the Hell of Blazing Fires. Chief amongst those pets are Rin Kaenbyou, the kasha in charge of the evil spirits, and Utsuho Reiuji, the hell raven who manages the depths of the Hell of Blazing Fires.

title: The Wicked Hermit Who Passes Through Walls
tagline: The Wicked Hermit Who Passes Through Walls; Notable figure of Gensokyo
age: More than 1400 years old, likely older than her colleagues.
theme_music: Old Yuanshen (Ten Desires)
first_appearance: Ten Desires (Stage 4 Midboss, Stage 4 Boss)
who_they_are: She acts to further her own goals, and nothing more, which is why she is labeled a wicked hermit and not accepted by the heavens. She doesn't seem to care about anyone, instead manipulating them for her own ends. Her revival of Yoshika's corpse shows her lack of regard for human rights.
personality: Seiga is a rather prideful girl who thinks Taoism is superior to other religions and tries to get people to convert. She acts to further her own goals, and nothing more, which is why she is labeled a wicked hermit and not accepted by the heavens. She doesn't seem to care about anyone, instead manipulating them for her own ends.

allies.name: Yoshika Miyako
allies.summary: She is the superior of Yoshika Miyako who is a guard of Hall of Dreams' Great Mausoleum. Seiga is very fond of Yoshika, often calling her "my cute underling".

allies.name: Mononobe no Futo
allies.summary: They were her allies, but Seiga's relationship with them doesn't seem to be particularly close.

allies.name: Soga no Tojiko
allies.summary: They were her allies, but Seiga's relationship with them doesn't seem to be particularly close.

allies.name: Toyosatomimi no Miko
allies.summary: Seiga trained Toyosatomimi no Miko in Taoist spells and charms. It seems to be a relationship of mutual respect, as in Reimu Hakurei's parallel ending Seiga calls Miko "Lady Toyosatomimi".

rivals.name: Marisa Kirisame
rivals.summary: Marisa fought Seiga. Some time before Symposium of Post-mysticism Marisa stole Seiga's veil, leading Seiga to break into her house to take it back.

acquaintances.name: Kasen Ibaraki
acquaintances.summary: Seiga briefly meets Kasen, though little interaction is had between the pair of hermits. Kasen notes that Seiga definitely seems like she's lived for too long.

title: Counterattacking Amanojaku
tagline: Counterattacking Amanojaku; Notable figure of Gensokyo
theme_music: Reverse Ideology (Double Dealing Character)
first_appearance: Double Dealing Character (Stage 5 Midboss, Stage 5 Boss, Stage 6 Midboss)
who_they_are: She's disliked and considered a nuisance, but welcomes that hatred towards her. She's more like a rebellious teenager who enjoys being against what everyone else thinks instead of someone who really wants to change things. This can be seen in her Spell Cards that flip the screen horizontally, vertically, and 180 degrees.
personality: Seija always thinks and acts the opposite to those around her. She's disliked and considered a nuisance, but welcomes that hatred towards her. She's more like a rebellious teenager who enjoys being against what everyone else thinks instead of someone who really wants to change things.

rivals.name: Reimu Hakurei
rivals.summary: Hunted fugitive during the Impossible Spell Card manhunt after refusing to surrender the Miracle Mallet.

acquaintances.name: Shinmyoumaru Sukuna
acquaintances.summary: Seija initially approached Shinmyoumaru Sukuna to persuade her to use the Miracle Mallet for her own ends. In order to do so, she falsified a history of the inchlings to turn the girl against society.

acquaintances.name: Benben Tsukumo
acquaintances.summary: Though no dialogue is exchanged between them, Seija appears to understand the heroine when they mention that a koto or biwa tsukumogami told them about her plan. As they all have the same objective, it is likely that they know each other.

acquaintances.name: Yatsuhashi Tsukumo
acquaintances.summary: Though no dialogue is exchanged between them, Seija appears to understand the heroine when they mention that a koto or biwa tsukumogami told them about her plan. As they all have the same objective, it is likely that they know each other.

acquaintances.name: Sagume Kishin
acquaintances.summary: While the two have not directly interacted,, Seija is very excited to see her and takes pride in the fact they are the same species, almost acting as if she's a celebrity. The encounter even encourages her to stay with Shinmyoumaru for the long haul.

title: The Pale Blue Eagle Ravi
tagline:
The Pale Blue Eagle Ravi; Lunarian military infiltrator (formerly), 
Dango Salesgirl (currently)
theme_music: The Rabbit Has Landed (Legacy of Lunatic Kingdom)
first_appearance: Legacy of Lunatic Kingdom (Stage 1 Midboss, Stage 1 Boss)
who_they_are: She was making mochi for them despite being on break, which confirms the latter. After staying on Earth for some years, Seiran became an Earth-loving Moon Rabbit. Seiran spends much of her scenario and win quotes praising Earth, and stating Earth is full of impurity and excitement.
personality: She has problems holding a regular conversation, even with her Moon Rabbit comrades, implying that she's either shy or doesn't get much respect from her fellow moon rabbits. She was making mochi for them despite being on break, which confirms the latter. After staying on Earth for some years, Seiran became an Earth-loving Moon Rabbit.

allies.name: Clownpiece
allies.summary: Fellow resident and companion associated with Sea of Tranquility (The Moon) (静かの海・月面).

allies.name: Junko
allies.summary: Fellow resident and companion associated with Sea of Tranquility (The Moon) (静かの海・月面).

rivals.name: Ringo
rivals.summary: Along with Ringo, both are members of the "Eagle Ravi" Earth Recon Unit sent to "purify" the Earth. After the events of Legacy of Lunatic Kingdom they both deserted the moon and became business rivals as Dango salesgirls.

acquaintances.name: Reisen Udongein Inaba
acquaintances.summary: She seem to have known Reisen before she fled to Gensokyo as both were part of the Lunarian Military.

title: The Rokurokubi Horror
tagline: Rokurokubi youkai living in disguise in the Human Village; member of the Grassroots Youkai Network
theme_music: Dullahan Under the Willows (Double Dealing Character)
first_appearance: Double Dealing Character (Stage 2 Midboss, Stage 2 Boss)
who_they_are: Sekibanki is a rokurokubi. She can make her head fly or stretch her neck out. Sekibanki lives in the Human Village under the guise of a human. She is a little prideful but avoids people and is rather cynical. She is good friends with Kagerou and Wakasagihime and is a part of the Grassroots Youkai Network. Sekibanki has short red hair and red eyes. Sekibanki wears a red and blue capelet she hides her lower face with, a black and red long sleeved shirt, and a red skirt.
key_facts: Lives quietly among the residents of the Human Village disguised as an aloof human woman in a red hooded cape, able to detach and fly her head independently.
personality: Cool, cynical, and guarded; prefers to keep a low profile in the village while hanging out with Kagerou and Wakasagihime.

allies.name: Kagerou Imaizumi
allies.summary: She is good friends with Kagerou and Wakasagihime and is a part of the Grassroots Youkai Network.

allies.name: Wakasagihime
allies.summary: She is good friends with Kagerou and Wakasagihime and is a part of the Grassroots Youkai Network.

title: The God of Makai
tagline: The God of Makai; God and creator of Makai
theme_music: 神話幻想　～ Infinite Being (Mystic Square)
first_appearance: Mystic Square (Stage 5 Cameo, Final Boss)
who_they_are: Shinki is a notable god figure of Gensokyo associated with God and creator of Makai.
personality: Known across Gensokyo for their distinctive presence and mastery of spiritual arts.

allies.name: Yumeko
allies.summary: Yumeko works as a maid for Shinki. Shinki has stated that Yumeko is her strongest creation.

acquaintances.name: Alice Margatroid
acquaintances.summary: Alice was a resident of Makai during the PC-98 era. However, with Alice living in the Forest of Magic in the Windows era, the relationship between Shinki and Alice Margatroid is never directly addressed.

title: Descendent of the Inchlings
tagline: Descendent of the Inchlings; Princess
theme_music: 輝く針の小人族　～ Little Princess (Double Dealing Character, Urban Legend in Limbo, Antinomy of Common Flowers)
first_appearance: Double Dealing Character (Stage 6 Boss)
who_they_are: She's somewhat gullible, and doesn't really use her head when acting. In a similar vein, she believed Seija Kijin's falsified history of the Inchlings, and assumes that the protagonist is joining her side when first meeting them (when they're using their weapons). She has a black and white view of the world, straightforwardly seeing herself as righteous and the world as evil.
personality: Shinmyoumaru has a straightforward and pure personality, although she has some twisted parts to her due to having an inferiority complex. She's somewhat gullible, and doesn't really use her head when acting. In a similar vein, she believed Seija Kijin's falsified history of the Inchlings, and assumes that the protagonist is joining her side when first meeting them (when they're using their weapons).

allies.name: Tenshi Hinanawi

rivals.summary: Komachi may have a grudge against Tenshi for how Tenshi flaunts her status of celestial, which Komachi feels is undeserved. The extent of this isn't known as no other game or manga touch upon this besides Scarlet Weather Rhapsody and Wild and Horned Hermit.

acquaintances.name: Suika Ibuki
acquaintances.summary: Suika traveled up to Heaven and beat up Tenshi to get some land. Iku mentions in her ending that Tenshi must have given it to her without consulting any of the other celestials about the matter.

acquaintances.name: Iku Nagae
acquaintances.summary: Iku comments to Tenshi that she was supposed to file a report before warning everyone about the earthquake, but couldn't because all of the Hinanawi clan were away from their homes.

acquaintances.name: Kasen Ibaraki
acquaintances.summary: Tenshi sees all hermits as her own personal servants and said it right in Kasen's face. Kasen secretly took offense but didn't bring that up to her.

acquaintances.name: Shion Yorigami
acquaintances.summary: Tenshi and Shion end up developing a strong and deep relationship with each other. Initially, Tenshi's brash attitude and privileged upbringing made Shion too shy to question her about even basic facts.

title: White Rabbit of Good Fortune

first_appearance: Imperishable Night (Stage 5 Midboss)
who_they_are: Tewi Inaba is an earth rabbit. She gives good luck to humans. She's the leader of the Earth rabbits, carefree but rather bratty and mischievous. Tewi lives in Eientei where she works with and regularly annoys Reisen. She is also Eirin's servant. Tewi is petite and has dark red eyes, black shoulder-length hair, and white droopy fluffy rabbit ears. Tewi wears a frilly pink nightgown, a carrot pendant and is barefoot.
key_facts: Over 1,300 years old (implied to be the White Hare of Inaba), she leads the earth rabbits of the Bamboo Forest and leased Eientei's land to Eirin and Kaguya.
Grants good fortune to lost travelers who spot her in the bamboo, while relentlessly digging pitfall traps and schemes to prank Reisen Udongein Inaba.
personality: Bratty, quick-witted, and unapologetically opportunistic; speaks like a shrewd boss running a racket behind cute rabbit ears.

allies.name: Eirin Yagokoro
allies.summary: Tewi made a deal with Eirin to defend Eientei in exchange for Eirin imparting her knowledge to the rabbits. Thus Eirin is an ally, employer and teacher to Tewi and Tewi appropriately addresses her as Master.

allies.name: Kaguya Houraisan
allies.summary: Over 1,300 years old (implied to be the White Hare of Inaba), she leads the earth rabbits of the Bamboo Forest and leased Eientei's land to Eirin and Kaguya.

acquaintances.name: Reisen Udongein Inaba
acquaintances.summary: Reisen is Tewi's fellow rabbit serving under Eirin. Unlike the youkai rabbits, Reisen acts as Tewi's superior, ordering Tewi around and being in charge of looking after her.

acquaintances.name: rabbit
acquaintances.summary: All of Gensokyo's youkai rabbits obey Tewi. Tewi knows every single youkai rabbit currently in Gensokyo, although this does not stem from the psychic connection that rabbits have.

who_they_are: , Toyosatomimi no Miko (豊聡耳 神子) is a saint and a type of hermit known as a shikaisen that resurrected from placing their soul in a treasured sword. Miko has the ability to hear up to ten people communicate at once with her as well as read their desires which made her very popular in the past. She now lives in her own version of Senkai.
personality: Miko is characterized as being "surprisingly casual", and frequently jokes around. Though she's a fully immortal hermit, she still tends to get involved in secular affairs because of her origins as a ruler. During combat, however, she displays no sign of weakness and seems to completely see through her opponents.

allies.name: People from the Myouren Temple
allies.summary: Miko and her allies initially had an antagonistic relationship with the residents of the Myouren Temple. The existence of a Buddhist faction led to the resurrection of the Hall of Dreams' Great Mausoleum.

rivals.name: Byakuren Hijiri
rivals.summary: Miko and Byakuren initially had an antagonistic relationship with one another, with Byakuren seeing her as a threat to the youkai, thus building her temple on top of the mausoleum to keep the former from resurrecting.

acquaintances.name: Hata no Kokoro
acquaintances.summary: Miko recognises Hata no Kokoro as the Tsukumogami Youkai of the 66 masks that Miko made for Hata no Kawakatsu, the legendary creator of Sarugaku (a form of Japanese theatre), before she was sealed.

abilities: Capable of slipping into places where one's soul is weak

who_they_are: Although she presents herself to be Megumu's faithful servant, she seems primarily interested in her own goals. Tsukasa's willingness to manipulate high-class youkai like Megumu, Gods like Chimata Tenkyuu, and even extremely powerful and dangerous youkai like Momoyo Himemushi, demonstrates a high degree of pride and confidence in her skills as a manipulator. She also addresses them in a very polite manner, calling them "Miss".
personality: Tsukasa is a sly kuda-gitsune who talks out of both sides of her mouth, acting as a "loyal" confidant to her mistress, Megumu Iizunamaru. Although she presents herself to be Megumu's faithful servant, she seems primarily interested in her own goals.

allies.name: Megumu Iizunamaru
allies.summary: She is Megumu Iizunamaru's right-hand and seems loyal to her, addressing her in very polite tones. However, Tsukasa is shown to manipulate Megumu all the same.

rivals.name: Misumaru Tamatsukuri
rivals.summary: Misumaru does not seem particularly enthralled by Tsukasa's manipulations, considering her a nuisance as Tsukasa disrupts Misumaru's attempts at a conflict-free resolution to the incident.

acquaintances.name: Momoyo Himemushi
acquaintances.summary: As a messenger for Megumu, Tsukasa brings her messages from Megumu to Momoyo, and vice versa. Tsukasa uses this by announcing that she will report Momoyo's apparent 'failure' to Megumu when the protagonist and Misumaru Tamatsukuri enter the cave, falsely branding them 'thieves'.

acquaintances.name: Chimata Tenkyuu
acquaintances.summary: Like with the other antagonists of Unconnected Marketeers, Tsukasa addresses Chimata in polite tones, but for her own gain.

personality: She's initially surprised to see the protagonists attempting to fly over the river, and threatens them in an attempt to chase them off (or possibly just to get some excitement, since the protagonists are strong enough to be considered "fair game" by some youkai).

allies.name: Kutaka Niwatari

acquaintances.name: Satori Komeiji

acquaintances.name: Kanako Yasaka
acquaintances.summary: She tells Utsuho in a dream to consume Yatagarasu and gain nuclear powers. However, Utsuho misunderstands her and uses these powers in an attempt to take over Gensokyo, which causes the events of Subterranean Animism.

acquaintances.name: Kagerou Imaizumi

Wriggle is energetic, caring about nature, but very forgetful and easily angered, especially by people who insult insects. Wriggle has blue eyes, teal hair, and bug-like antennae. She wears a white shirt, a black cape with red lining that looks like insect wings, blue shorts, and red shoes.

She is willing to use underhanded methods to succeed in her goal, including eliminating potential inconveniences if necessary. She views human and animal spirits as resources and believes that cooperation is impossible in the animal realm and that competition is the way to make progress.

allies.name: Saki Kurokoma
allies.summary: Saki gets along terribly with Yachie, referring to the dragon turtle as "foul" or "creepy", but respects her strength. Yachie at least seems to respect the Keiga clan wolf spirits.

allies.name: Yuuma Toutetsu
allies.summary: It is unknown how Yachie thinks about Yuuma. However, considering that the Kiketsu Family and the Gouyoku Family formed an alliance during the events of Wily Beast and Weakest Creature, it is believed that their relationship is neutral, if not bad.

allies.name: Son Biten
allies.summary: Yachie contacted Biten supposedly to prevent her to fall to Hell, but she was only using this pretext to make her help the Kiketsu family in its surface invasion. Yachie seems to treat Biten as any of her subordinates: as mere pieces to move to achieve an objective.

rivals.name: Keiki Haniyasushin
rivals.summary: Yachie views Keiki as a competition and therefore a worthy opponent for the sake of progress. However, she also sees Keiki as an old enemy to get rid of in the struggle for resources.

acquaintances.name: Myouren Temple
acquaintances.summary: Yamame once tried to join the Myouren Temple, but got rejected by Byakuren because she said the reason for joining the temple was "because the humans that come to the temple with their worries look delicious".

personality: Yatsuhashi plays the role of the reckless and hot-blooded little sister, in contrast with her more mature big sister. However, they both dream of a utopia where tools could move freely without the need of youkai or humans using them.

title: Half-Human Half-Phantom Gardener

age: At least 30, implied closer to 50 (as of 2004), less than 60 (as of 2005)
theme_music: 広有射怪鳥事　～ Till When? (Perfect Cherry Blossom, Immaterial and Missing Power, Scarlet Weather Rhapsody)
first_appearance: Perfect Cherry Blossom (Stage 5 Midboss, Stage 5 Boss, Stage 6 Midboss)
who_they_are: Youmu Konpaku is a half-phantom half-human, and expert swordswoman. Youmu lives in Hakugyokurou as a servant of Yuyuko. Youmu is straightforward, diligent, but easily manipulated. Youmu has silver eyes, silver hair and a black hairband with a large black ribbon. Her phantom-half manifests as a wisp-shaped ghost following her. She wears a green vest, green skirt, with a white shirt underneath. Youmu dual wields a katana called Roukanken and a wakizashi called Hakurouken.
key_facts: Serves Yuyuko Saigyouji at Hakugyokurou in the Netherworld, maintaining its vast white gravel gardens, preparing meals, and acting as sword instructor.
Wields the twin ancestral blades Roukanken (forged by oni, capable of cutting ten phantoms in one swing) and Hakurouken (which severs a target's spiritual confusion).
Despite being half-phantom and living in the Netherworld, she is terrified of ghost stories and the dark.
personality: Formal, earnest samurai-retainer diction that fractures rapidly when teased by Yuyuko or startled by anything spooky.

allies.name: Yuyuko Saigyouji
allies.summary: Youmu's mistress, ever since Youmu was born (stated by Youmu). Youmu is completely loyal to her, but has trouble understanding her.

allies.name: Youki Konpaku
allies.summary: Youmu was Youki's student, and also his successor as the gardener of Hakugyokurou. She believes that his disappearance is some kind of lesson from him.

allies.name: Yukari Yakumo
allies.summary: The friend of Youmu's mistress. Youmu respects her greatly and she helps Youmu with lessons and advice, but Youmu doesn't understand her, either.

allies.name: Eiki Shiki, Yamaxanadu
allies.summary: As a yama, Eiki is one of the superiors of Youmu's mistress, Yuyuko. Youmu is aware of the role of the yama and respects Eiki greatly, but hadn't met her in-person until Phantasmagoria of Flower View.

allies.name: Reimu Hakurei
allies.summary: Youmu is friends with Reimu and Marisa, though the two often pick on her due to her straightforward and earnest personality.

allies.name: Marisa Kirisame
allies.summary: Youmu is friends with Reimu and Marisa, though the two often pick on her due to her straightforward and earnest personality.

allies.name: Eika Ebisu
allies.summary: Stillborn Idol of the Riverbed; Notable figure of Gensokyo When defeated by Youmu and the otter spirit, she casually accepts the situation and wastes no time in arranging a different type of contest instead.

acquaintances.name: Eientei
acquaintances.summary: From Imperishable Night, Youmu is one of the few characters that is aware that three of the residents of Eientei are from the Moon, and presumably keeping it a secret like the others.

acquaintances.name: Komachi Onozuka
acquaintances.summary: Youmu and Komachi first met. As a ferryman under the yama, Komachi could also be considered a fellow employee of sorts with Youmu, although their lines of work do not cross very often.

title: The Key Weak Point of the Magnificent Capital
tagline: The Key Weak Point of the Magnificent Capital; Notable figure of Gensokyo
abilities: Causing things to be reborn by feeding them to her snake
theme_music: Reminiscence of Deer-Hunting (Fossilized Wonders)
first_appearance: Fossilized Wonders (Stage 4 boss, Extra stage midboss)
who_they_are: She enjoys deer hunting, and even asks the heroine if she wants to join her after being defeated. Kanako Yasaka claims to know her before she was brainwashed by the Lunarians and comments that she was also "peculiar" back then. However, her snake has its limits: during the events of Fossilized Wonders, the wave of information from the Outside World was too much for it to handle.
personality: Yuiman enjoyed her life when she was the princess of Yuimankoku, to the point she didn't mind being forced to work for the Lunarians because the Pit of Four Seasons where she was imprisoned was designed to resemble the landscapes of her former home. She enjoys deer hunting, and even asks the heroine if she wants to join her after being defeated.

allies.name: Ariya Iwanaga
allies.summary: Ariya and Yuiman were both worshipped as the gods of the Asama Purifying Mountain in the past. Ariya's profile suggests that her main motivation for causing the incident in Fossilized Wonders was to save Yuiman, and that doing so made "her heart of stone" shift, implying a close bond between the two.

allies.name: Kanako Yasaka
allies.summary: Kanako claims to know Yuiman from before, and calls Yuiman a 'old friend' before she was brainwashed by the Lunarians as a goddess of her hometown and wishes she gets liberated from the Lunarian's control.

allies.name: Nareko Michigami
allies.summary: Fellow resident and companion associated with Asama Purifying Mountain (浅間浄穢山).

title: Youkai of Boundaries
tagline: Mastermind behind the Great Hakurei Barrier, manipulator of boundaries, and preeminent Sage of Gensokyo
occupation: Sage, maintaining Gensokyo's balance and order
age: At least 1,200 years old, older than the history of Gensokyo itself
theme_music: Necrofantasia (Perfect Cherry Blossom)
first_appearance: Perfect Cherry Blossom (Phantasm Boss)
who_they_are: Yukari Yakumo is a unique youkai. She can manipulate the boundaries of anything. Yukari likes to sleep, and enjoys life freely. She is one of the Sages of Gensokyo. Yukari is a manipulative mastermind and is secretive about her real goals. Yukari is friendly towards Reimu but messes with her. Yukari is best friends with Yuyuko, friends with Suika, and Ran is her Shikigami. Yukari is tall and mature-looking. Yukari has gold eyes and very long blonde hair with many red ribbons. She wears a purple tabard with trigrams over a pale pink Western dress with black sleeve cuffs. Yukari wears a pink mob cap with a red ribbon, and usually carries a parasol.
key_facts: Ancient youkai Sage who co-created the Great Hakurei Barrier in 1885 and proposed the Vampire Contract and Spell Card Rules to preserve Gensokyo's balance.
Manipulates boundaries between any two concepts—day and night, life and death, reality and fantasy, or physical space via violet eye-filled dimensional gaps.
Hibernates during winter while her kitsune shikigami Ran Yakumo manages household affairs at Mayohiga and barrier maintenance calculations.
personality: Silky, aristocratic, and endlessly amused; speaks in layered riddles where even a casual pleasantry serves three separate strategic goals.

allies.name: Reimu Hakurei
allies.summary: Yukari has always had a close tie to the Hakurei Shrine maidens, as one meaning of her name is she controls the Shrine Maidens of Gensokyo. Reimu Hakurei, along with Marisa Kirisame, first met Yukari when she asked her to repair the border between the Netherworld and Gensokyo.

allies.name: Marisa Kirisame
allies.summary: Yukari has always had a close tie to the Hakurei Shrine maidens, as one meaning of her name is she controls the Shrine Maidens of Gensokyo. Reimu Hakurei, along with Marisa Kirisame, first met Yukari when she asked her to repair the border between the Netherworld and Gensokyo.

allies.name: Ran Yakumo
allies.summary: Ran Yakumo is Yukari's main shikigami, a nine-tailed fox who received her current name and identity as part of their contract. An interview with Aya Shameimaru implies that she became Yukari's shikigami because of the power it promised, and is quite satisfied with the result despite losing her freedom.

allies.name: Chen
allies.summary: Ran also has a shikigami named Chen. As Ran's shikigami, Chen follows the will of both Ran Yakumo and Yukari Yakumo, though her shikigami "programming" is not as unified with her original personality as Ran's is, and it's implied she's quite the handful as a result.

allies.name: Yukari's crows
allies.summary: Zenki and Goki are two crows that Yukari and Ran use as shikigami. They might be temporary names for all shikigami crows, as one gets killed by Watatsuki no Toyohime, yet three more spy for Yukari later.

allies.name: Yuyuko Saigyouji
allies.summary: Yukari and Yuyuko were friends even while Yuyuko was alive more than a thousand years ago, and continued to be Yuyuko's friend after she became a ghost. Of note is that this friendship between Yuyuko and Yukari does not extend to Yukari's shikigami Ran, and Yuyuko does not mind others beating Ran up.

allies.name: Youmu Konpaku
allies.summary: Being Yuyuko's servant, Yukari helps Youmu with lessons and advice every once in a while, like.

allies.name: Suika Ibuki
allies.summary: Yukari was Suika Ibuki's friend before the oni went underground. It is unknown how or when they became friends.

rivals.name: Eiki Shiki, Yamaxanadu
rivals.summary: When Yukari senses Eiki approaching in Seasonal Dream Vision, she and Yuyuko leave immediately to avoid talking with her. Perfect Memento in Strict Sense notes that most long-lived youkai were assisted by Eiki at least once and avoid her due to her lectures.

rivals.name: Keine Kamishirasawa
rivals.summary: Yukari and Keine met and fought at the Human Village. Keine's ability to hide history has no effect on Yukari, who didn't even know she was using her ability in the first place.

rivals.name: Tenshi Hinanawi
rivals.summary: Because Tenshi destroys the Hakurei Shrine and attempts to build a keystone into the new shrine's foundation, and because she generally looks down on Gensokyo's residents, she is one of the few characters who have made Yukari visibly angry. Their dialogue implies that Yukari still did not completely forgive her.

acquaintances.name: Yuugi Hoshiguma
acquaintances.summary: Yuugi is one of the oni (presumably Suika is another) that Yukari made a deal with. In exchange for keeping the evil spirits of Old Hell in control, Yukari would give them their own place in the Underworld and keep the overworld youkai from intruding.

acquaintances.name: Kasen Ibaraki
acquaintances.summary: It is unknown how long Yukari and Kasen have known each other, but both are youkai sages. The monologue states it was the youkai sages who proposed the Hakurei Barrier, so Yukari and Kasen probably knew each other since at least that time.

acquaintances.name: Remilia Scarlet
acquaintances.summary: Yukari uses Remilia as part of her scheme to extract the residence tax and get revenge on the Lunarians. Patchouli reveals Remilia knew she was manipulated but didn't care, because she was bored.

acquaintances.name: Patchouli Knowledge
acquaintances.summary: Patchouli first meets Yukari in her scenario. Yukari places her in charge of watching the underworld in her victory quote to her.

acquaintances.name: Maribel Hearn
acquaintances.summary: When ZUN was asked about Yukari's and Maribel's relationship in a high school open lecture, he did not say much beyond mentioning Lafcadio Hearn's name and laughing.

acquaintances.name: Alice Margatroid
acquaintances.summary: For whatever reason, Alice Margatroid is willing to confront Yukari despite otherwise avoiding strong youkai such as Remilia Scarlet and Yuyuko Saigyouji. Yukari's also set up Alice's dolls off-page to allow for long-range communications.

title: Witch
tagline: Witch; Witch
theme_music: 禁断の魔法　～ Forbidden Magic (Mystic Square)
first_appearance: Mystic Square (Stage 4 Boss A)
who_they_are: Yuki is a notable witch figure of Gensokyo associated with Witch.
personality: Known across Gensokyo for their distinctive presence and mastery of magic.

allies.name: Mai
allies.summary: Mai is a Witch like Yuki, and it is possible that the two are friends. During the fourth stage of Mystic Square, Yuki will become enraged if Mai is defeated before her.

allies.name: Mai Teireida
allies.summary: Fellow resident and companion associated with World of Ice and Snow (Makai) (氷雪の世界).

allies.name: Letty Whiterock
allies.summary: Yuki-onna who embodies the chill of winter across Gensokyo Letty Whiterock is a yuki-onna.

acquaintances.name: Shinki
acquaintances.summary: Shinki is the creator of Makai and may also have created Yuki.

tagline: Makai Maid; Maid
theme_music: 悲しき人形　～ Doll of Misery (Mystic Square)
first_appearance: Mystic Square (Stage 5 Boss)
who_they_are: Yumeko is a notable unknown, probably youkai or demon figure of Gensokyo associated with Maid.
personality: Known across Gensokyo for their distinctive presence and mastery of spiritual arts.

allies.name: Shinki
allies.summary: Shinki is the creator of Makai and it is known that Shinki has created Yumeko because Shinki states that she's her strongest creation. Due to her occupation, it is supposed that Yumeko serves Shinki, but anything else about their relationship is unknown.

title: Fantasy Legend
tagline: Fantasy Legend; Professor
theme_music: Strawberry Crisis!! (Phantasmagoria of Dim. Dream)
first_appearance: Phantasmagoria of Dim.Dream (Cover, Playable Character, Final Boss)
who_they_are: Yumemi Okazaki is a notable human figure of Gensokyo associated with Professor.
personality: Known across Gensokyo for their distinctive presence and mastery of artificial magic.

allies.name: Ruukoto
allies.summary: Ruukoto is a former maid of Yumemi and is Yumemi's creation. She is now owned by Reimu Hakurei in the PC-98.

allies.name: Maribel Hearn
allies.summary: Fellow resident and companion associated with Probability Space Hypervessel & Outside World Rift (可能性空間移動船・外の世界).

allies.summary: Fellow resident and companion associated with Probability Space Hypervessel & Outside World Rift (可能性空間移動船・外の世界).

acquaintances.name: Chiyuri Kitashirakawa
acquaintances.summary: Chiyuri is an assistant of Yumemi. As such, Yumemi entrusts Chiyuri with several tasks in order to help her get her goals of collecting information for her research.

acquaintances.name: Mimi-chan
acquaintances.summary: Mimi-chan is a weapon and a creation of Yumemi's. She is now owned by Marisa Kirisame in the PC-98.

title: The So-Called Unexplainable Phenomenon
tagline: The So-Called Unexplainable Phenomenon; Manager of Old Hell’s Hot Spring Town
occupation: Manager of Old Hell’s Hot Spring Town
abilities: Wielding unexplainable phenomena, Possessing superhuman strength
theme_music: A Flower-Studded Sake Dish on Mt. Ooe (Subterranean Animism)
first_appearance: Subterranean Animism (Stage 3 Midboss, Stage 3 Boss)
who_they_are: She likes those who are strong and brave, and has no mercy for the weak and cowardly. While she may be intimidating, she can be very friendly and sympathetic towards anyone regardless if they're a human, youkai or a vengeful spirit. She has arguably the greatest super-strength, as even Suika, that was considered the strongest in this sense by the time of Silent Sinner in Blue, admits that Yuugi might be physically stronger than she is.
personality: Yuugi is a very firm and straightforward oni who loves the freedom of Old Hell. She likes those who are strong and brave, and has no mercy for the weak and cowardly. While she may be intimidating, she can be very friendly and sympathetic towards anyone regardless if they're a human, youkai or a vengeful spirit.

allies.name: Suika Ibuki
allies.summary: Yuugi is old friends with Suika, and presumably with the other two Big Four of the Mountain. Yuugi is jealous of the fact Suika is able to freely travel around.

allies.name: Marisa Kirisame
allies.summary: The two seem to be on friendly terms, with Marisa mentioning that the oni often invites her to the underground to drink together.

allies.name: Koishi Komeiji
allies.summary: Fellow resident and companion associated with The Underworld (Subterranean Cavern) (地底界).

allies.name: Satori Komeiji
allies.summary: Fellow resident and companion associated with The Underworld (Subterranean Cavern) (地底界).

acquaintances.name: Kasen Ibaraki
acquaintances.summary: Kasen describes Yuugi as an acquaintance of hers when she used the oni's sake dish to make her own sake better.
