age: At least over , implied to be very old.
theme_music: 眠れる恐怖　～ Sleeping Terror (Lotus Land Story)
first_appearance: Lotus Land Story (Stage 5 Boss, Final Boss)
who_they_are: Yuuka Kazami (風見 幽香) is a long-lived youkai called the "Flower Master of the Four Seasons" whose main place of activity is the Garden of the Sun during Phantasmagoria of Flower View. Whereas when Yuuka first debuted in Lotus Land Story from the PC-98 games, she was the master of a mansion in the Fantasy World who wanted the Hakurei Shrine destroyed out of boredom.
personality:
]]
Yuuka is a youkai who holds strength in high regard, ignoring other people unless they are strong youkai or humans with special abilities. However, it is also said she enjoys rubbing people the wrong way. She does it either by teasing those who she sees as weaker than her or even going around taking advantage of her link with flowers to joke claiming she is the culprit of the flower incident, just to see a reaction.

allies.name: Eternity Larva
allies.summary: Fellow resident and companion associated with Garden of the Sun (太陽の畑).

allies.name: Medicine Melancholy
allies.summary: Fellow resident and companion associated with Garden of the Sun (太陽の畑).

acquaintances.name: Reimu Hakurei
acquaintances.summary: It appears that Yuuka has known Reimu Hakurei and Marisa Kirisame before the events of Phantasmagoria of Flower View through meeting them during Lotus Land Story. She describes Marisa as "grown up quite a bit" and tells Reimu that she's "still a poor shrine maiden".

acquaintances.name: Marisa Kirisame
acquaintances.summary: It appears that Yuuka has known Reimu Hakurei and Marisa Kirisame before the events of Phantasmagoria of Flower View through meeting them during Lotus Land Story. She describes Marisa as "grown up quite a bit" and tells Reimu that she's "still a poor shrine maiden".

acquaintances.name: Elly
acquaintances.summary: Yuuka seems to have some kind of relationship with Elly, since she's the gatekeeper of Mugenkan.

title: Undefeated Matriarch of the Gouyoku Alliance
tagline: Undefeated Matriarch of the Gouyoku Alliance; Chairwoman of the Gouyoku Alliance
theme_music: Memento of the Avaricious Beast (Sunken Fossil World, Unfinished Dream of All Living Ghost)
first_appearance: Wily Beast and Weakest Creature (mentioned)
who_they_are: However, it seems she doesn't think twice before attacking someone if she thinks her business is in danger, as she attacks multiple heroines thinking they were there to steal her oil.
personality: She is clever, calculating, and avoids pointless conflict by nature. However, it seems she doesn't think twice before attacking someone if she thinks her business is in danger, as she attacks multiple heroines thinking they were there to steal her oil.

rivals.name: Saki Kurokoma
rivals.summary: Similarly to Yachie, Yuuma and Saki are the leaders of opposing factions in the Animal Realm, so they are enemies.

acquaintances.name: Yachie Kicchou
acquaintances.summary: Given they are leaders of opposing factions in the Animal Realm, they are antagonistic of each other. However, considering that both of their factions teamed up during the events of Wily Beast and Weakest Creature, their relationship might not be as terrible as it seemed.

acquaintances.name: Okina Matara
acquaintances.summary: After getting defeated by Flandre Scarlet per Okina's request, Yuuma agreed to co-manage the Hell of Blood Pools along with Okina.

acquaintances.name: Chiyari Tenkajin
acquaintances.summary: Chiyari and Yuuma have similar laid back personalities and both reside in the Former Hell's Blood Pools. This makes them a perfect match and they hit off immediately.

acquaintances.name: Ran Yakumo
acquaintances.summary: In Unfinished Dream of All Living Ghost it is revealed that Ran used to live in Animal Realm and knew Yuuma before she was the leader of Gouyoku Alliance. She had left due to being disgusted by the "beastly ideology" of the Animal Realm.

title: Ghost of Idyll
tagline: Ghost princess and mistress of Hakugyokurou in the Netherworld; manipulator of death
abilities: Manipulation of death, Manipulation of departed souls
age: Dead/Immortal (Presumed to have "died over 1000 years ago". Born sometime in the 12th cent
theme_music: 幽雅に咲かせ、墨染の桜　～ Border of Life (Perfect Cherry Blossom, Immaterial and Missing Power, Scarlet Weather Rhapsody)
first_appearance: Perfect Cherry Blossom (Final Boss)
who_they_are: Yuyuko Saigyouji is a ghost princess. Yuyuko can manipulate death and departed spirits. She is very cheerful, friendly, and is a gourmet. Yuyuko may seem like an airhead, but is actually cunning and smart. She manages the Netherworld and is the mistress of Hakugyokurou. Youmu is her servant and Yukari is her best friend. Yuyuko is the subordinate of Eiki Shiki. Yuyuko has brown eyes and short wavy pink hair. She is surrounded by small spirits. Yuyuko wears a light blue kimono with black trim and spirit motifs, and a blue mob cap.
key_facts: Presides over departed spirits in the Netherworld beneath the giant ghostly cherry tree Saigyou Ayakashi, under which her own mortal body is sealed.
Can invite any mortal creature to instant, painless death without resistance, though she refrains from using this power in daily life and enjoys a millennia-long friendship with Yukari Yakumo.
Possesses a legendary appetite and playful demeanor that mask one of the sharpest strategic minds in Gensokyo.
personality: Airy, whimsical, and sing-song; drifts effortlessly from teasing Youmu about snacks to dropping a piercing observation that cuts to the core of an incident.

allies.name: Youmu Konpaku
allies.summary: Youmu is Yuyuko's gardener, bodyguard, and fencing instructor. Youmu is unquestioningly loyal to her master, though she has a hard time understanding Yuyuko's riddles.

allies.name: Yukari Yakumo
allies.summary: Yuyuko has been friends with Yukari since before her death, and is one of the few people who can see through her plans.

acquaintances.name: Youki Konpaku
acquaintances.summary: Youki is Youmu's predecessor, who taught Youmu all that she knows. He also knew the full story of Yuyuko's connection to the Saigyou Ayakashi even after Yuyuko herself had forgotten.

acquaintances.name: Eiki Shiki, Yamaxanadu
acquaintances.summary: Yuyuko was appointed her position by the yama, therefore it can be assumed that Eiki outranks her (Yuyuko also refers to Eiki as "Eiki-Sama"). Yuyuko knows Eiki personally, as Eiki dropped by to push her to teach Youmu more in Youmu's ending.

acquaintances.name: Saigyou Ayakashi
acquaintances.summary: Her corpse was buried by an unknown person under the Saigyou Ayakashi after she committed suicide.

title: King of the Silent Bliss of Nirvana
tagline: King of the Silent Bliss of Nirvana; Ruler/Manager of Gensokyo's Hell
age: Roughly 500 years old. (Lived during the Sengoku period, with its start date generally con
theme_music: The Deviants' Unobstructed Light 〜 Kingdom of Nothingness. (Unfinished Dream of All Living Ghost)
first_appearance: Unfinished Dream of All Living Ghost (Playable Character, Possible Opponent)
who_they_are: She has both the strength and intelligence that an oni should be portraying, which made her a "intelligentsia". That said and although she made it for selfish reasons, she is also seen to have a sense of grace, seeking a (relatively) peaceful resolution to the beast wars and to protect Gensokyo from destruction. In this sense, she shares much in common with Reimu, feeling a sense of communality.
personality: Zanmu is described as the perfect oni according to Suika. She has both the strength and intelligence that an oni should be portraying, which made her a "intelligentsia". That said and although she made it for selfish reasons, she is also seen to have a sense of grace, seeking a (relatively) peaceful resolution to the beast wars and to protect Gensokyo from destruction.

allies.name: Son Biten
allies.summary: Zanmu manipulated events such that Biten was able to transform into an oni and meet up with Yachie. Biten then became a loyal minion of hers.

allies.name: Suika Ibuki
allies.summary: Suika and Zanmu know each other since the time when Former Hell was known as Hell. Suika shows a high degree of respect in Zanmu, noting she is a true oni among oni.

acquaintances.name: Hisami Yomotsu
acquaintances.summary: Hisami is Zanmu's assistant, carrying out orders and bringing people to her. Hisami has a one-way infatuation with Zanmu; she tries her best to gain Zanmu's attention.

acquaintances.name: Enoko Mitsugashira
acquaintances.summary: Once upon a time, Enoko ate Zanmu's flesh while Zanmu was a human. Even as Zanmu's flesh was being eaten, she kept laughing.

acquaintances.name: Chiyari Tenkajin
acquaintances.summary: Chiyari and Zanmu knew each other back when Former Hell was known as Hell. Chiyari holds great admiration for Zanmu due to the resentment she caused for all the creatures left behind by moving Hell.

acquaintances.name: Reimu Hakurei
acquaintances.summary: Zanmu laments how Reimu resembles how she was like back when she was human. She entrusts the balance and security of Gensokyo to Reimu, abandoning her plans.

acquaintances.name: Saki Kurokoma
acquaintances.summary: Saki is infatuated by Zanmu's oni coolness. Her high regard for Zanmu convinced her to back down and monitor the situation instead of fighting.

acquaintances.name: Yuuma Toutetsu
acquaintances.summary: Zanmu holds Yuuma in high regard, naming her the top dog of the animal realm. Their relationship seems to be antagonistic.
